import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import { ArrowUp, LoaderCircle, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';

type ArchiveChangeProposal = {
  collection: 'tools' | 'notes' | 'watchlist';
  operation: 'add' | 'update';
  targetId?: string;
  summary: string;
  fields: Record<string, unknown>;
  confirmationToken: string;
  expiresAt: number;
};
type Citation = { title: string; url: string };
type ChatMessage = { role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string; citations?: Citation[]; pendingChange?: ArchiveChangeProposal; applied?: boolean };

export const AIChatView: React.FC = () => {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [applyingIndex, setApplyingIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const endRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    endRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
  }, [messages, isLoading]);

  const sendMessage = async (value = draft) => {
    const content = value.trim();
    if (!content || isLoading) return;
    const priorMessages = messages;
    const nextMessages: ChatMessage[] = [...priorMessages, { role: 'user', content }];
    setMessages(nextMessages);
    setDraft('');
    setError('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message: content, history: priorMessages.slice(-8) }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      const payload = typeof result.reply === 'string' ? { reply: result.reply } : result.reply;
      if (!response.ok || !result.ok || !payload || typeof payload.reply !== 'string') {
        throw new Error(result.error || 'The assistant could not respond. Please try again.');
      }
      setMessages((current) => [...current, {
        role: 'assistant',
        content: payload.reply,
        citations: Array.isArray(payload.citations) ? payload.citations : Array.isArray(result.citations) ? result.citations : [],
        pendingChange: payload.pendingChange || result.pendingChange,
      }]);
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'The assistant could not respond.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      inputRef.current?.focus();
    }
  };

  const applyProposal = async (proposal: ArchiveChangeProposal, messageIndex: number) => {
    setApplyingIndex(messageIndex);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/ai/apply', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ proposal }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || !result.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Could not apply the proposed change.');
      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current.map((message, index) => index === messageIndex ? { ...message, pendingChange: undefined, applied: true } : message),
        { role: 'assistant', content: result.summary },
      ]);
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Could not apply the proposed change.');
    } finally {
      setApplyingIndex(null);
    }
  };

  const dismissProposal = (messageIndex: number) => {
    setMessages((current) => current.map((message, index) => index === messageIndex ? { ...message, pendingChange: undefined, applied: false } : message));
  };

  const handleSubmit = (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    void sendMessage();
  };

  return (
    <section className="mx-auto flex h-full min-h-[calc(100dvh-7rem)] max-w-4xl flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#09090b] text-zinc-100">
      <div className="flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-5 sm:px-8 sm:py-8" aria-live="polite" aria-relevant="additions text">
        {messages.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[46vh] max-w-xl flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
            <Sparkles className="mb-5 h-7 w-7 text-zinc-200" aria-label="AI assistant" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white sm:text-3xl">How can I help?</h1>
            <p className="mt-3 max-w-lg text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-400">
              Ask about anything online or in your archive. I can search the web, read your saved items, and suggest ideas.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-6">
            {messages.map((message, index) => (
              <article key={`${index}-${message.role}`} className={`flex gap-3 ${message.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}>
                {message.role === 'assistant' && (
                  <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.06]">
                    <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-200" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className={`max-w-[85%] break-words text-sm leading-7 ${message.role === 'user' ? 'whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-2xl bg-[#202023] px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-100' : 'pt-0.5 text-zinc-300'} `}>
                  <div className={message.role === 'assistant' ? '[&_a]:text-zinc-100 [&_a]:underline [&_h1]:mb-2 [&_h1]:mt-4 [&_h1]:text-lg [&_h1]:font-semibold [&_h2]:mb-2 [&_h2]:mt-4 [&_h2]:text-base [&_h2]:font-semibold [&_li]:ml-5 [&_li]:list-disc [&_ol_li]:list-decimal [&_p]:my-2 [&_strong]:font-semibold [&_table]:min-w-full [&_td]:border [&_td]:border-white/10 [&_td]:px-2 [&_td]:py-1 [&_th]:border [&_th]:border-white/10 [&_th]:bg-white/5 [&_th]:px-2 [&_th]:py-1 [&_ul]:my-2' : ''}>
                    {message.role === 'assistant' ? <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>{message.content}</ReactMarkdown> : message.content}
                  </div>
                  {Boolean(message.citations?.length) && (
                    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                      <span>Google Search</span>
                      {message.citations?.map((citation) => (
                        <a key={citation.url} href={citation.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-zinc-400 underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-white">
                          {citation.title}
                        </a>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {message.pendingChange && (
                    <div className="mt-4 max-w-xl rounded-2xl bg-[#171719] p-4">
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Review archive change</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">{message.pendingChange.summary}</p>
                      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        <button type="button" disabled={applyingIndex === index} onClick={() => void applyProposal(message.pendingChange!, index)} className="rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 disabled:opacity-50">
                          {applyingIndex === index ? 'Applying…' : 'Apply change'}
                        </button>
                        <button type="button" disabled={applyingIndex === index} onClick={() => dismissProposal(index)} className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white disabled:opacity-50">
                          Dismiss
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {message.applied === false && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">Proposal dismissed.</p>}
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
            {isLoading && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-zinc-500" role="status">
                <LoaderCircle className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                Thinking…
              </div>
            )}
            {error && <p className="ml-10 text-xs text-rose-300" role="alert">{error}</p>}
            <div ref={endRef} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {messages.length === 0 && error && <p className="px-6 pb-2 text-center text-xs text-rose-300" role="alert">{error}</p>}

      <div className="bg-[#09090b] px-3 pb-4 pt-3 sm:px-6 sm:pb-6">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mx-auto max-w-2xl">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#151517] p-2">
            <textarea
              ref={inputRef}
              value={draft}
              onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey && !event.nativeEvent.isComposing && event.keyCode !== 229) {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  void sendMessage();
                }
              }}
              maxLength={2000}
              rows={2}
              placeholder="Message 0arc AI…"
              aria-label="Message 0arc AI"
              className="max-h-36 min-h-12 w-full resize-y bg-transparent px-2 py-2 text-sm leading-6 text-white outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-600"
            />
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 px-1 pb-0.5">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!draft.trim() || isLoading}
                aria-label="Send message"
                className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white text-black transition hover:bg-zinc-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-white/[0.08] disabled:text-zinc-600"
              >
                {isLoading ? <LoaderCircle className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <ArrowUp className="h-4 w-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import {
  Cloud,
  Database,
  Check,
  AlertTriangle,
  X,
  ExternalLink,
  RefreshCw,
  Server,
  Lock,
  Layers,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface CloudSyncModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const CloudSyncModal: React.FC<CloudSyncModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const {
    isCloudSyncActive,
    mongoStatus,
    connectMongoAtlas,
    disconnectMongoAtlas,
    forceCloudSync,
    tools,
    notes,
    media,
    addToast,
  } = useArchive();

  const [mongoUri, setMongoUri] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingNow, setSyncingNow] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const totalItems = tools.length + notes.length + media.length;
  const isMongo = mongoStatus?.isMongoConnected;

  const handleConnectMongo = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!mongoUri.trim()) return;

    setStatusMessage(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await connectMongoAtlas(mongoUri.trim());
      if (res.ok) {
        setStatusMessage({
          type: 'success',
          text: 'Connected to MongoDB Atlas! Your vault is now synced directly with MongoDB.',
        });
        setMongoUri('');
      } else {
        setStatusMessage({
          type: 'error',
          text: res.message || 'Failed to connect to MongoDB cluster.',
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Connection failed.',
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnectMongo = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await disconnectMongoAtlas();
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: 'Reverted to the built-in persistent cloud store.',
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleForceSync = async () => {
    setSyncingNow(true);
    try {
      await forceCloudSync();
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `All ${totalItems} vault items successfully synchronized with the cloud!`,
      });
    } finally {
      setSyncingNow(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg surface-elevated border border-white/[0.1] rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/[0.08]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/[0.08] text-white">
              <Cloud className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Cloud Database & Real-Time Sync</h2>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                Cross-device synchronization across browsers & devices
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Current Status Banner */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-mono space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-white">
                {isMongo ? 'MongoDB Atlas Cloud Active' : 'Persistent Cloud Storage Active'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
              Real-Time
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300 font-sans leading-relaxed">
            Data is automatically saved to the cloud and continuously synced in the background. Changes reflect instantly on any device or browser without refresh or lag.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Live Metrics Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.06]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-zinc-500 block">Tools</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white font-mono">{tools.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.06]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-zinc-500 block">Notes</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white font-mono">{notes.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.06]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-zinc-500 block">Watchlist</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white font-mono">{media.length}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status Alert */}
        {statusMessage && (
          <div
            className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-2 ${
              statusMessage.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'
                : 'bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/20 text-red-300'
            }`}
          >
            {statusMessage.type === 'success' ? (
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <span>{statusMessage.text}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Quick Sync Action */}
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white block">Manual Force Sync</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Push immediate snapshot to all connected clients</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleForceSync}
            disabled={syncingNow}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.1] text-xs font-mono text-zinc-200 border border-white/[0.1] transition-colors shrink-0 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${syncingNow ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />

        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-white/[0.08] space-y-3">

              <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>MongoDB Atlas Integration</span>
            </div>
            {isMongo && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-500/20">
                Connected
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
            By default, your data is securely stored in the cloud engine. You can optionally connect your own free MongoDB Atlas cluster to store your vault documents directly in MongoDB.

              <span className="text-zinc-400 truncate">{mongoStatus.mongoUriMasked}</span>

import React from 'react';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { Search, X, Wrench, FileText, Film, ArrowRight, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import { MediaType, NavigationTab } from '../../types';

const TYPE_LABELS: Record<MediaType, string> = {
  movie: 'Movie',
  series: 'Series',
  anime: 'Anime',
};

interface SearchResultItem {
  id: string;
  category: 'tool' | 'note' | 'media';
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  detail?: string;
  targetTab: NavigationTab;
  url?: string;
}

export const GlobalSearchModal: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    searchModalOpen,
    closeSearchModal,
    tools,
    notes,
    media,
    setActiveTab,
  } = useArchive();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeCategoryFilter, setActiveCategoryFilter] = useState<'all' | 'tool' | 'note' | 'media'>('all');
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (searchModalOpen) {
      setQuery('');
      setActiveCategoryFilter('all');
      setSelectedIndex(0);
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    }
  }, [searchModalOpen]);

  // Compute matched results
  const results: SearchResultItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const items: SearchResultItem[] = [];

    // Tools
    for (const tool of tools) {
      if (
        !q ||
        tool.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        tool.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        tool.category.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ) {
        items.push({
          id: tool.id,
          category: 'tool',
          title: tool.title,
          subtitle: `${tool.category} · Tool`,
          detail: tool.description,
          targetTab: 'tools',
          url: tool.url,
        });
      }
    }

    // Notes
    for (const note of notes) {
      if (
        !q ||
        note.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        note.content.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        note.category.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        note.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      ) {
        items.push({
          id: note.id,
          category: 'note',
          title: note.title,
          subtitle: `${note.category} · Note`,
          detail: note.content.slice(0, 90),
          targetTab: 'notes',
        });
      }
    }

    // Media
    for (const m of media) {
      if (
        !q ||
        m.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        m.genre.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (m.notes && m.notes.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      ) {
        items.push({
          id: m.id,
          category: 'media',
          title: m.title,
          subtitle: `${TYPE_LABELS[m.type]} · ${m.genre} (${m.releaseYear})`,
          detail: m.description,
          targetTab: 'watchlist',
        });
      }
    }

    // Filter by active category tab if selected
    const filtered =
      activeCategoryFilter === 'all'
        ? items
        : items.filter((item) => item.category === activeCategoryFilter);

    // If query is empty, show latest 8 items
    return q ? filtered : filtered.slice(0, 8);
  }, [query, activeCategoryFilter, tools, notes, media]);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      closeSearchModal();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex((prev) => (results.length > 0 ? (prev + 1) % results.length : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex((prev) => (results.length > 0 ? (prev - 1 + results.length) % results.length : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (results[selectedIndex]) {
        handleSelectItem(results[selectedIndex]);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: SearchResultItem) => {
    setActiveTab(item.targetTab);
    closeSearchModal();
  };

  if (!searchModalOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-0 sm:pt-24 px-0 sm:px-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150"
      onClick={closeSearchModal}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-2xl h-[100dvh] sm:h-auto sm:max-h-[80vh] surface-elevated rounded-none sm:rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 border border-white/[0.08]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Search Input Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-white/[0.06] gap-3">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setQuery(e.target.value);
              setSelectedIndex(0);
            }}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            placeholder="Search across all archives..."
            className="w-full bg-transparent text-white placeholder-zinc-500 text-sm focus:outline-none"
          />
          {query ? (
            <button
              onClick={() => setQuery('')}
              className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white p-1 rounded transition-colors"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <span className="hidden sm:inline text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/[0.08]">
              Esc
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Category Pill Filters */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-white/[0.06] flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none">
          {[
            { id: 'all', label: 'All Results' },
            { id: 'tool', label: 'Tools' },
            { id: 'note', label: 'Notes' },
            { id: 'media', label: 'Watchlist' },
          ].map((cat) => {
            const active = activeCategoryFilter === cat.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setActiveCategoryFilter(cat.id as typeof activeCategoryFilter);
                  setSelectedIndex(0);
                }}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-mono transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-white/[0.1] text-white font-medium border border-white/[0.1]'
                    : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-white/[0.03]'
                }`}
              >
                {cat.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Results Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-2">
          {results.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-500 text-xs">
              <p className="font-medium text-zinc-300 mb-1">No matching items found</p>
              <p>Try searching for different keywords or clear filters.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
                <span>{query ? `${results.length} matches` : 'Recent entries'}</span>
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Press ↵ to jump</span>
              </div>
              {results.map((item, idx) => {
                const isSelected = idx === selectedIndex;
                const categoryIcons = {
                  tool: <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />,
                  note: <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />,
                  media: <Film className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />,
                };

                return (
                  <button
                    key={`${item.category}-${item.id}`}
                    onClick={() => handleSelectItem(item)}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(idx)}
                    className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between gap-3 transition-colors ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-white/[0.08] text-white'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-white/[0.03]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                      <div className="p-1.5 rounded-md bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/[0.08] shrink-0">
                        {categoryIcons[item.category]}
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-white truncate">{item.title}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 truncate">· {item.subtitle}</span>
                        </div>
                        {item.detail && (
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 line-clamp-1 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                            {item.detail}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                      {isSelected ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-300">
                          <span>Open</span>
                          <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        item.url && <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-600" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer hints (desktop only) */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-t border-white/[0.06] hidden sm:flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <kbd className="kbd-shortcut">↑</kbd>
              <kbd className="kbd-shortcut">↓</kbd>
              <span>navigate</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <kbd className="kbd-shortcut">↵</kbd>
              <span>select</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <kbd className="kbd-shortcut">esc</kbd>
            <span>close</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface LogoProps {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  showTagline?: boolean;
}

export const Logo: React.FC<LogoProps> = ({ size = 'md', showTagline = false }) => {
  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'text-sm',
    md: 'text-base',
    lg: 'text-lg',
  };

  const glyphSizeClasses = {
    sm: 'w-4 h-4 text-[10px]',
    md: 'w-5 h-5 text-xs',
    lg: 'w-6 h-6 text-sm',
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 select-none group cursor-pointer">
      {/* Precision styled 0 glyph badge */}
      <div
        className={`${glyphSizeClasses[size]} rounded-md bg-white text-black flex items-center justify-center font-mono font-bold shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105`}
      >
        <span className="leading-none">0</span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 leading-none">
          <span
            className={`font-semibold tracking-tight text-white ${sizeClasses[size]}`}
          >
            arc
          </span>
        </div>
        {showTagline && (
          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono tracking-tight mt-0.5">
            Everything worth keeping
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { X, Wrench, FileText, Film, Loader2, Check, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { ToolCategory, MediaType, MediaStatus } from '../../types';
import { lookupMediaDetails, searchMedia, type MediaCandidate } from '../../lib/mediaLookup';

type QuickAddType = 'tool' | 'note' | 'watchlist';

interface MediaPreview {
  title?: string;
  type?: MediaType;
  posterUrl?: string;
  description?: string;
  genre?: string;
  releaseYear?: number;
  rating?: number;
}

const ADD_STATUSES: { value: MediaStatus; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'want_to_watch', label: 'Watchlist' },
  { value: 'watching', label: 'Watching' },
  { value: 'completed', label: 'Completed' },
];

export const QuickAddModal: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    quickAddModalOpen,
    quickAddInitialType,
    closeQuickAdd,
    addTool,
    addNote,
    addMedia,
  } = useArchive();

  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<QuickAddType>('tool');

  // Tool
  const [toolTitle, setToolTitle] = useState('');
  const [toolDesc, setToolDesc] = useState('');
  const [toolUrl, setToolUrl] = useState('');
  const [toolCategory, setToolCategory] = useState<ToolCategory>('Productivity');
  const [toolTags, setToolTags] = useState('');

  // Note
  const [noteTitle, setNoteTitle] = useState('');
  const [noteCategory, setNoteCategory] = useState('General');
  const [noteContent, setNoteContent] = useState('');

  // Watchlist
  const [mediaTitle, setMediaTitle] = useState('');
  const [mediaStatus, setMediaStatus] = useState<MediaStatus>('want_to_watch');
  const [mediaLoading, setMediaLoading] = useState(false);
  const [imdbCandidates, setImdbCandidates] = useState<MediaCandidate[]>([]);
  const [isSearchingImdb, setIsSearchingImdb] = useState(false);
  const [showCandidates, setShowCandidates] = useState(false);
  const [mediaPreview, setMediaPreview] = useState<MediaPreview | null>(null);
  const [pendingMedia, setPendingMedia] = useState<MediaPreview[]>([]);
  const searchTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setToolTitle('');
    setToolDesc('');
    setToolUrl('');
    setToolCategory('Productivity');
    setToolTags('');
    setNoteTitle('');
    setNoteCategory('General');
    setNoteContent('');
    setMediaTitle('');
    setMediaStatus('want_to_watch');
    setMediaPreview(null);
    setPendingMedia([]);
    setMediaLoading(false);
    setImdbCandidates([]);
    setShowCandidates(false);
  };

  // Start every "New Entry" from a clean form, pre-selecting the requested section.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!quickAddModalOpen) return;
    resetForm();
    if (quickAddInitialType === 'notes') setSelectedType('note');
    else if (quickAddInitialType === 'watchlist') setSelectedType('watchlist');
    else setSelectedType('tool');
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [quickAddModalOpen, quickAddInitialType]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (searchTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!quickAddModalOpen) return null;

  const searchImdbCandidates = async (queryToSearch: string) => {
    setIsSearchingImdb(true);
    try {
      const results = await searchMedia(queryToSearch);
      setImdbCandidates(results);
      setShowCandidates(results.length > 0);
    } catch {
      // Offline — the entry can still be saved manually.
      setImdbCandidates([]);
    } finally {
      setIsSearchingImdb(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMediaTitleChange = (value: string) => {
    setMediaTitle(value);
    setMediaPreview(null);

    if (searchTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimerRef.current);

    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed.length >= 2) {
      searchTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => searchImdbCandidates(trimmed), 350);
    } else {
      setImdbCandidates([]);
      setShowCandidates(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchDetails = async (body: {
    title: string;
    year?: number;
    type?: MediaType;
    imdbId?: string;
    posterUrl?: string;
  }): Promise<MediaPreview | null> => {
    try {
      return await lookupMediaDetails(body);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const handleSelectCandidate = async (candidate: MediaCandidate) => {
    setShowCandidates(false);
    setMediaLoading(true);
    const details = await fetchDetails({
      title: candidate.title,
      year: candidate.year,
      type: candidate.type,
      imdbId: candidate.id,
      posterUrl: candidate.posterUrl,
    });
    const selected = details
      ? { ...details, title: details.title || candidate.title, type: details.type || candidate.type, posterUrl: details.posterUrl || candidate.posterUrl }
      : { title: candidate.title, type: candidate.type, posterUrl: candidate.posterUrl };
    setPendingMedia((current) => [...current.filter((item) => item.title !== selected.title), selected]);
    setMediaTitle('');
    setMediaPreview(null);
    setImdbCandidates([]);
    setMediaLoading(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (selectedType === 'tool') {
      if (!toolTitle.trim() || !toolDesc.trim()) return;
      const tagsArray = toolTags
        .split(',')
        .map((tag) => tag.trim().toLowerCase())
        .filter(Boolean);
      addTool({
        title: toolTitle.trim(),
        description: toolDesc.trim(),
        url: toolUrl.trim() || undefined,
        category: toolCategory,
        tags: tagsArray.length > 0 ? tagsArray : [toolCategory.toLowerCase()],
        isFavorite: false,
      });
    } else if (selectedType === 'note') {
      if (!noteTitle.trim()) return;
      addNote({
        title: noteTitle.trim(),
        content: noteContent.trim(),
        category: noteCategory.trim() || 'General',
        tags: [],
        isFavorite: false,
      });
    } else {
      const title = mediaTitle.trim();
      let itemsToAdd = pendingMedia;

      if (title) {
        setMediaLoading(true);
        const manualPreview = (await fetchDetails({ title, type: mediaPreview?.type })) || mediaPreview;
        setMediaLoading(false);
        itemsToAdd = [...itemsToAdd, manualPreview || { title, type: 'movie' }];
      }

      if (itemsToAdd.length === 0) return;

      itemsToAdd.forEach((item) => {
        addMedia({
          title: item.title || 'Untitled',
          type: item.type || 'movie',
          description: item.description || 'Saved to your watchlist.',
          posterUrl: item.posterUrl,
          genre: item.genre || 'Uncategorized',
          releaseYear: item.releaseYear || new Date().getFullYear(),
          rating: item.rating || 0,
          status: mediaStatus,
          isFavorite: false,
        });
      });
    }

    closeQuickAdd();
  };

  const typeOptions: { id: QuickAddType; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { id: 'tool', label: 'Tool', icon: <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
    { id: 'note', label: 'Note', icon: <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
    { id: 'watchlist', label: 'Watchlist', icon: <Film className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
  ];

  const inputClass =
    'w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm text-white placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg surface-elevated rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] border border-white/[0.08] pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] sm:pb-0">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-white/15 sm:hidden shrink-0" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] shrink-0">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">New Entry</h2>
          <button
            onClick={closeQuickAdd}
            className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-2 -mr-2 rounded-md hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition-colors"
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Entry type selector */}
        <div className="px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] shrink-0">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 p-1 bg-white/[0.03] rounded-lg border border-white/[0.06]">
            {typeOptions.map((option) => {
              const active = selectedType === option.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={option.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedType(option.id);
                    setShowCandidates(false);
                  }}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-2 rounded-md text-xs transition-colors ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-white text-black font-semibold shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  {option.icon}
                  <span>{option.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col">
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4">
            {selectedType === 'tool' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">Name</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    autoFocus
                    placeholder="e.g. Cursor, Linear, Raycast"
                    value={toolTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setToolTitle(e.target.value)}
                    className={inputClass}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                    Description
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    required
                    rows={2}
                    placeholder="What makes this tool worth keeping?"
                    value={toolDesc}
                    onChange={(e) => setToolDesc(e.target.value)}
                    className={`${inputClass} resize-none`}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                      URL (optional)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="url"
                      inputMode="url"
                      placeholder="https://..."
                      value={toolUrl}
                      onChange={(e) => setToolUrl(e.target.value)}
                      className={`${inputClass} font-mono text-[13px]`}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                      Category
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={toolCategory}
                      onChange={(e) => setToolCategory(e.target.value as ToolCategory)}
                      className={`${inputClass} font-mono`}
                    >
                      <option value="AI Tools">AI Tools</option>
                      <option value="Development">Development</option>
                      <option value="Design">Design</option>
                      <option value="Productivity">Productivity</option>
                      <option value="Websites">Websites</option>
                      <option value="Software">Software</option>
                      <option value="Learning">Learning</option>
                      <option value="Other">Other</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                    Tags (comma separated)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. dev, design, utility"
                    value={toolTags}
                    onChange={(e) => setToolTags(e.target.value)}
                    className={`${inputClass} font-mono text-[13px]`}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {selectedType === 'note' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">Title</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    autoFocus
                    placeholder="Note title"
                    value={noteTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setNoteTitle(e.target.value)}
                    className={inputClass}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                    Category
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="General"
                    value={noteCategory}
                    onChange={(e) => setNoteCategory(e.target.value)}
                    className={inputClass}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">Content</label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={5}
                    placeholder="Write your note here..."
                    value={noteContent}
                    onChange={(e) => setNoteContent(e.target.value)}
                    className={`${inputClass} resize-none`}
                  />
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {selectedType === 'watchlist' && (
              <>
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">Title</label>
                    {isSearchingImdb && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
                        <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                        <span>Searching...</span>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required={pendingMedia.length === 0}
                      autoFocus
                      placeholder="e.g. Dune, Severance, Frieren"
                      value={mediaTitle}
                      onChange={(e) => handleMediaTitleChange(e.target.value)}
                      onFocus={() => {
                        if (imdbCandidates.length > 0) setShowCandidates(true);
                      }}
                      className={inputClass}
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => searchImdbCandidates(mediaTitle)}
                      disabled={isSearchingImdb || !mediaTitle.trim()}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.1] border border-white/[0.1] text-xs font-mono text-white transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 shrink-0"
                      aria-label="Search for a match"
                    >
                      {isSearchingImdb ? (
                        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                      ) : (
                        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-300" />
                      )}
                      <span className="hidden sm:inline">Find</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {showCandidates && imdbCandidates.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 z-50 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.14] bg-[#18181c]/95 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-56 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain divide-y divide-white/[0.04]">
                      <div className="px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-white/[0.03] flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0">
                        <span>Pick the exact match</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setShowCandidates(false)}
                          className="hover:text-white px-2 py-1 -my-1"
                        >
                          Close
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      {imdbCandidates.map((candidate) => (
                        <button
                          key={candidate.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSelectCandidate(candidate)}
                          className="w-full text-left p-2.5 flex items-center gap-3 hover:bg-white/[0.06] active:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors"
                        >
                          {candidate.posterUrl ? (
                            <img
                              src={candidate.posterUrl}
                              alt=""
                              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                              className="w-9 h-12 object-cover rounded bg-black shrink-0 border border-white/[0.08]"
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <div className="w-9 h-12 rounded bg-black/60 shrink-0 border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-center">
                              <Film className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-500" />
                            </div>
                          )}
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white truncate">
                                {candidate.title}
                              </span>
                              {candidate.year && (
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1 rounded bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-400 shrink-0">
                                  {candidate.year}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 truncate mt-0.5 font-mono uppercase">
                              {candidate.rawType || candidate.type}
                              {candidate.stars ? ` · ${candidate.stars}` : ''}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">Status</label>
                  <select
                    value={mediaStatus}
                    onChange={(e) => setMediaStatus(e.target.value as MediaStatus)}
                    className={`${inputClass} font-mono`}
                  >
                    {ADD_STATUSES.map((status) => (
                      <option key={status.value} value={status.value}>
                        {status.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {pendingMedia.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {pendingMedia.map((item) => (
                      <div
                        key={`${item.type}-${item.title}`}
                        className="flex gap-3 rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.035] p-3"
                      >
                        <div className="h-16 w-11 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-white/[0.06]">
                          {item.posterUrl ? (
                            <img src={item.posterUrl} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                            <div>
                              <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-white">{item.title}</p>
                              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">
                                {item.type === 'anime' ? 'Anime' : item.type === 'series' ? 'Series' : 'Movie'}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setPendingMedia((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.title !== item.title))}
                              className="shrink-0 text-zinc-500 hover:text-white"
                              aria-label={`Remove ${item.title}`}
                            >
                              ×
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-400">
                            {item.description || 'No synopsis available.'}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {mediaPreview?.description && (
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.025] border border-white/[0.08] flex gap-3 items-start">
                    {mediaPreview.posterUrl ? (
                      <img
                        src={mediaPreview.posterUrl}
                        alt=""
                        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                        className="w-14 h-20 object-cover rounded bg-black/60 shrink-0 border border-white/[0.1]"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-14 h-20 rounded bg-black/60 shrink-0 border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-center">
                        <Film className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-500" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white truncate">
                        {mediaPreview.title || mediaTitle}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
                        {mediaPreview.releaseYear}
                        {mediaPreview.genre ? ` · ${mediaPreview.genre}` : ''}
                        {mediaPreview.rating ? ` · ★ ${mediaPreview.rating}/10` : ''}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                        {mediaPreview.description}
                      </p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400">
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3" />
                        <span>Poster & synopsis added</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {!mediaPreview?.description && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 leading-relaxed">

const DB_NAME = '0arc-image-gallery';
const STORE_NAME = 'images';
const ACCEPTED_IMAGES = 'image/*,.avif,.bmp,.gif,.heic,.heif,.jpeg,.jpg,.png,.svg,.tif,.tiff,.webp';
const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

const createId = () =>
  typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID
    ? crypto.randomUUID()
    : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;

const openDatabase = () =>
  new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
    request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  });

const dataUrlToBlob = (dataUrl: string) => {
  const [header, body] = dataUrl.split(',', 2);
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(body || ''), (char) => char.charCodeAt(0));
  return new Blob([bytes], { type: header.match(/data:(.*?);/)?.[1] || 'application/octet-stream' });
};

const imageToCloud = async (image: StoredImage) => ({
  ...image,
  dataUrl: await blobToDataUrl(image.blob),
  blob: undefined,
});

export const readImages = async (): Promise<StoredImage[]> => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/cloud/images');
    if (response.ok) {
      const payload = await response.json();
      if (payload.ok && Array.isArray(payload.images)) {
        return payload.images.map((image: any) => ({
          id: String(image.id), name: String(image.name), type: String(image.type),
          size: Number(image.size), originalSize: image.originalSize ? Number(image.originalSize) : undefined,
          createdAt: Number(image.createdAt), blob: dataUrlToBlob(String(image.dataUrl)),
        }));
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'MongoDB image storage unavailable');
  }
  throw new Error('MongoDB image storage unavailable');
};

export const writeImages = async (images: StoredImage[]) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/cloud/images', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ images: await Promise.all(images.map(imageToCloud)) }),
    });
    if (response.ok) return;
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'MongoDB image storage unavailable');
  }
  throw new Error('MongoDB image storage unavailable');
};

export const removeImage = async (id: string) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/cloud/images/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    if (response.ok) return;
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'MongoDB image storage unavailable');
  }
  throw new Error('MongoDB image storage unavailable');
};

export const formatSize = (bytes: number) => {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

const blobToDataUrl = (blob: Blob) =>
  new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result));
    reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error);
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });

/** Formats worth re-encoding; SVG/GIF (vector/animation) and already-optimised
 *  WebP/AVIF/HEIC uploads keep their original bytes. */
const RECOMPRESSIBLE_TYPES = new Set(['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/bmp']);

/** High enough that the WebP copy is visually indistinguishable from the source. */
const WEBP_QUALITY = 0.95;

/**
 * Shrink an upload without dropping resolution or visible detail.
 * The re-encoded copy is only kept when it is meaningfully smaller than the
 * original file, so quality can never get worse for no gain.
 */
const compressImage = async (file: File): Promise<File> => {
  if (!RECOMPRESSIBLE_TYPES.has(file.type) || file.size < 20 * 1024) return file;
  if (typeof createImageBitmap !== 'function') return file;

  try {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: 'from-image' });
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = bitmap.width;
    canvas.height = bitmap.height;

    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!context) {
      bitmap.close();
      return file;
    }

    context.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0);
    bitmap.close();

    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) =>
      canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/webp', WEBP_QUALITY)
    );

    if (!blob || blob.size === 0 || blob.size > file.size * 0.95) return file;

    const name = file.name.replace(/\.(png|jpe?g|bmp)$/i, '') + '.webp';
    return new File([blob], name, { type: 'image/webp', lastModified: file.lastModified });
  } catch {
    // Formats the browser can't decode (HEIC, TIFF, huge canvases) stay untouched.
    return file;
  }
};

const compressForExport = async (blob: Blob) => {
  if (blob.type === 'image/svg+xml' || blob.type === 'image/gif') return blobToDataUrl(blob);
  try {
    const sourceUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const image = new Image();
    image.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    image.src = sourceUrl;
    await image.decode();
    const scale = Math.min(1, 1600 / Math.max(image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight));
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(image.naturalWidth * scale));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(image.naturalHeight * scale));
    canvas.getContext('2d')?.drawImage(image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(sourceUrl);
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/webp', 0.78);
  } catch {
    return blobToDataUrl(blob);
  }
};

export async function exportGalleryImages(): Promise<GalleryExportImage[]> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('indexedDB' in window)) return [];
  try {
    const stored = await readImages();
    return Promise.all(
      stored.map(async (image) => ({
        id: image.id,
        name: image.name,
        type: image.type,
        size: image.size,
        createdAt: image.createdAt,
        dataUrl: await compressForExport(image.blob),
      }))
    );
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

    if (!('indexedDB' in window)) {
      setError('IndexedDB storage is not supported in this browser environment.');
      setIsLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    void refreshImages();
    return () => {
      images.forEach((image) => URL.revokeObjectURL(image.url));
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // Keyboard shortcut to close preview modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (selectedImage) setSelectedImage(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [selectedImage]);

  const saveFiles = async (fileList: File[]) => {
    const validFiles = fileList.filter(
      (file) =>
        file.type.startsWith('image/') ||
        file.name.match(/\.(avif|bmp|gif|heic|heif|jpe?g|png|svg|tiff?|webp)$/i)
    );
    if (!validFiles.length) return;

    setError('');
    try {
      // Compress on upload, keeping the original whenever no bytes are saved.
      const prepared = await Promise.all(
        validFiles.map(async (file) => {
          const optimized = await compressImage(file);
          return {
            id: createId(),
            name: optimized.name,
            type: optimized.type || file.type || 'image/*',
            size: optimized.size,
            originalSize: optimized !== file ? file.size : undefined,
            createdAt: Date.now(),
            blob: optimized,
          };
        })
      );

      const oversized = prepared.filter((image) => image.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES);
      if (oversized.length) {
        throw new Error(`${oversized.length} image${oversized.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} exceed the 10 MB upload limit.`);
      }

      await writeImages(prepared);
      await refreshImages();

      const bytesBefore = validFiles.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0);
      const bytesAfter = prepared.reduce((sum, image) => sum + image.size, 0);
      const savedPercent =
        bytesBefore > 0 ? Math.round(((bytesBefore - bytesAfter) / bytesBefore) * 100) : 0;

      if (prepared.length === 1) {
        addToast(
          'Image Saved',
          'success',
          savedPercent > 0
            ? `${prepared[0].name} · ${formatSize(bytesBefore)} → ${formatSize(bytesAfter)} (${savedPercent}% smaller)`
            : prepared[0].name
        );
      } else {
        addToast(
          `${prepared.length} Images Saved`,
          'success',
          savedPercent > 0
            ? `${savedPercent}% smaller · ${formatSize(bytesBefore - bytesAfter)} saved`
            : 'Added to image archive'
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'MongoDB image storage is unavailable.';
      setError(message);
      addToast('Upload Failed', 'error', message);
    }
  };

  const handleFileInput = async (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = Array.from(event.target.files || []);
    await saveFiles(files);
    event.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(false);

    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
      const droppedFiles = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files);
      await saveFiles(droppedFiles);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteImage = async (image: GalleryImage) => {
    if (settings.confirmBeforeDelete) {
      setImageToDelete(image);
    } else {
      await executeDelete(image);
    }
  };

  const executeDelete = async (image: GalleryImage) => {
    try {
      await removeImage(image.id);
      if (selectedImage?.id === image.id) setSelectedImage(null);
      await refreshImages();
      addToast('Image Removed', 'info', `Deleted "${image.name}"`);
    } catch {
      addToast('Delete Failed', 'error', 'Could not delete image.');
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = (image: GalleryImage, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = image.url;
    link.download = image.name;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  const filteredImages = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = images.filter((img) => !q || img.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));

    return filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case 'oldest':
          return a.createdAt - b.createdAt;
        case 'name':
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        case 'size_desc':
          return b.size - a.size;
        case 'size_asc':
          return a.size - b.size;
        case 'recent':
        default:
          return b.createdAt - a.createdAt;
      }
    });
  }, [images, searchQuery, sortBy]);

  const selectClass =
    'px-2.5 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]';

  return (
    <div
      onDragOver={handleDragOver}
      onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
      onDrop={handleDrop}
      className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in duration-150 relative"
    >
      {/* Hidden file input */}
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="file"
        accept={ACCEPTED_IMAGES}
        multiple
        onChange={handleFileInput}
        className="sr-only"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {/* Drag overlay */}
      {isDragging && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-30 rounded-2xl bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-2 border-dashed border-white/50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 pointer-events-none animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <ImagePlus className="w-10 h-10 text-white mb-2 animate-bounce" />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Drop images to save</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1">PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, HEIC</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white tracking-tight">Images</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
            {images.length} {images.length === 1 ? 'image' : 'images'} saved in your private reference archive.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-zinc-200 text-black text-xs font-medium transition-colors shrink-0 shadow-sm"
        >
          <ImagePlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Add Images</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Error alert */}
      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-xs text-red-300">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search & Sort Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2.5">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
          <input
            type="search"
            placeholder="Search saved images by filename..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]"
          />
        </div>

        <select
          value={sortBy}
          onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as any)}
          className={selectClass}
          aria-label="Sort images"
        >
          <option value="recent">Newest first</option>
          <option value="oldest">Oldest first</option>
          <option value="name">Name (A–Z)</option>
          <option value="size_desc">Size (Largest)</option>
          <option value="size_asc">Size (Smallest)</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Loading State */}
      {isLoading && (
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">
          Loading image gallery...
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Empty State */}
      {!isLoading && filteredImages.length === 0 && (
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-12 text-center space-y-3">
          <FileImage className="w-8 h-8 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
              {images.length === 0 ? 'Your image gallery is empty' : 'No images matched your search'}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">
              {images.length === 0
                ? 'Drop screenshots, logos, design assets, and inspirations from your computer.'
                : 'Try adjusting your search query or sorting options.'}
            </p>
          </div>
          {images.length === 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 text-xs font-medium transition-colors"
            >
              <ImagePlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Choose Files</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Image Grid */}
      {!isLoading && filteredImages.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
          {filteredImages.map((image) => {
            const ext = image.name.split('.').pop()?.toUpperCase() || 'IMG';

            return (
              <div
                key={image.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedImage(image)}
                role="button"
                tabIndex={0}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setSelectedImage(image);
                  }
                }}
                className="surface-card rounded-xl overflow-hidden group flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer relative hover:border-white/[0.18] transition-all focus:outline-none focus-visible:border-white/30"
              >
                {/* Thumbnail container */}
                <div className="aspect-[4/3] w-full bg-[#0a0a0c] relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
                  <img
                    src={image.url}
                    alt={image.name}
                    loading="lazy"
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
                  />

                  {/* Gradient bottom shadow */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

                  {/* Format pill */}
                  <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/[0.08] text-[9px] font-mono font-medium text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {ext}
                  </div>

                  {/* Hover expand button */}
                  <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/[0.08] text-white opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                    <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </div>

                  {/* Size bottom badge */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-1.5 left-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-300">
                    {formatSize(image.size)}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Footer bar */}
                <div className="p-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
                  <p className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-200" title={image.name}>
                    {image.name}
                  </p>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => handleDownload(image, e)}
                      title={`Download ${image.name}`}
                      className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        void handleDeleteImage(image);
                      }}
                      title={`Delete ${image.name}`}
                      className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-400/10 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Fullscreen Lightbox Modal */}
      {selectedImage && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-6 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label={`Preview ${selectedImage.name}`}
          onClick={() => setSelectedImage(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="relative flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] max-w-5xl w-full surface-elevated rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.12] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0c0c0e]">
              <div className="min-w-0 pr-3">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white truncate" title={selectedImage.name}>
                  {selectedImage.name}
                </h3>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <HardDrive className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-500" />
                    {formatSize(selectedImage.size)}
                    {selectedImage.originalSize && selectedImage.originalSize > selectedImage.size && (
                      <span className="text-emerald-400">
                        · compressed{' '}
                        {Math.round((1 - selectedImage.size / selectedImage.originalSize) * 100)}%
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-500" />
                    {new Date(selectedImage.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleDownload(selectedImage)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] border border-white/[0.1] text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline">Download</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    void handleDeleteImage(selectedImage);
                  }}
                  className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 transition-colors"
                  title="Delete image"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedImage(null)}
                  className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.1] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  aria-label="Close preview"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Image Display */}
            <div className="flex-1 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-hidden min-h-[300px] max-h-[75vh]">
              <img
                src={selectedImage.url}
                alt={selectedImage.name}
                className="max-h-full max-w-full object-contain rounded-lg shadow-lg select-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete confirmation modal */}
      <ConfirmModal
        isOpen={Boolean(imageToDelete)}
        title="Delete image?"
        description={`Are you sure you want to permanently delete "${imageToDelete?.name}" from your gallery?`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        onConfirm={() => {
          if (imageToDelete) {
            void executeDelete(imageToDelete);
            setImageToDelete(null);
          }
        }}
        onCancel={() => setImageToDelete(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { NavigationTab } from '../../types';
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  MessageSquareText,
  Wrench,
  FileText,
  Film,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Star,
  Settings,
} from 'lucide-react';

export const Sidebar: React.FC = () => {
  const { activeTab, setActiveTab } = useArchive();

  const navItems: { id: NavigationTab; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: <LayoutDashboard className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'ai', label: 'AI', icon: <MessageSquareText className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'tools', label: 'Tools', icon: <Wrench className="w-4 h-4" /> },
