    { id: 'watchlist', label: 'Watchlist', icon: <Film className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'images', label: 'Images', icon: <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'favorites', label: 'Favorites', icon: <Star className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: <Settings className="w-4 h-4" /> },
  ];

  return (
    <aside className="hidden md:flex w-14 shrink-0 bg-[#0c0c0d] border-r border-white/[0.06] flex-col items-center justify-between py-4 select-none z-30">
      {/* Top: 0arc minimal glyph */}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('overview')}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { NoteItem } from '../../types';
import { ConfirmModal } from '../common/ConfirmModal';
import { Plus, Search, Star, Trash2, FileText, ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';

export const NotesView: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    notes,
    addNote,
    updateNote,
    deleteNote,
    toggleNoteFavorite,
    settings,
  } = useArchive();

  const [activeNoteId, setActiveNoteId] = useState<string | null>(notes[0]?.id || null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [favoritesOnly, setFavoritesOnly] = useState(false);
  const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<'saved' | 'saving'>('saved');
  const [noteToDelete, setNoteToDelete] = useState<NoteItem | null>(null);
  // Phones show either the list or the editor, never both at once.
  const [mobileEditorOpen, setMobileEditorOpen] = useState(false);

  const activeNote = notes.find((n) => n.id === activeNoteId) || notes[0] || null;

  // Categories
  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    notes.forEach((n) => {
      if (n.category) set.add(n.category);
    });
    return ['All', ...Array.from(set)];
  }, [notes]);

  // Filtered notes
  const filteredNotes = useMemo(() => {
    return notes.filter((n) => {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesQuery =
        !q ||
        n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        n.content.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        n.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q));

      const matchesCategory =
        selectedCategory === 'All' || n.category === selectedCategory;

      const matchesFav = !favoritesOnly || n.isFavorite;

      return matchesQuery && matchesCategory && matchesFav;
    });
  }, [notes, searchQuery, selectedCategory, favoritesOnly]);

  const handleCreateNewNote = () => {
    const newNote = addNote({
      title: '',
      content: '',
      category: 'General',
      tags: [],
      isFavorite: false,
    });
    setActiveNoteId(newNote.id);
    setMobileEditorOpen(true);
  };

  const handleTitleChange = (newTitle: string) => {
    if (!activeNote) return;
    setSaveStatus('saving');
    updateNote(activeNote.id, { title: newTitle });
    setTimeout(() => setSaveStatus('saved'), 350);
  };

  const handleContentChange = (newContent: string) => {
    if (!activeNote) return;
    setSaveStatus('saving');
    updateNote(activeNote.id, { content: newContent });
    setTimeout(() => setSaveStatus('saved'), 350);
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (cat: string) => {
    if (!activeNote) return;
    updateNote(activeNote.id, { category: cat });
  };

  // Stats
  const wordCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeNote || !activeNote.content) return 0;
    return activeNote.content.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  }, [activeNote]);

  const readTime = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wordCount / 200));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col animate-in fade-in duration-150 md:h-[calc(100dvh-8rem)]">
      {/* Two-Column Clean Notes Workspace */}
      <div className="flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-0 border border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#111113]">
        {/* Left Column: Note List */}
        <div
          className={`md:col-span-4 border-r border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0e0e10] flex-col h-[calc(100dvh-11rem)] md:h-full ${
            mobileEditorOpen ? 'hidden md:flex' : 'flex'
          }`}
        >
          {/* Header & Search */}
          <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400">Notes</span>
              <button
                onClick={handleCreateNewNote}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 text-xs font-medium transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>New</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.06] text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Category tabs */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none pt-0.5">
              {categories.map((cat) => {
                const active = selectedCategory === cat;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={cat}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                      active
                        ? 'bg-white/[0.1] text-white font-medium'
                        : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cat}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Notes List */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-white/[0.03]">
            {filteredNotes.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-500 text-xs">
                <FileText className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto mb-2 text-zinc-600" />
                <p>No notes found</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              filteredNotes.map((note) => {
                const isActive = activeNote?.id === note.id;
                const previewText = note.content.replace(/[#*`_>]/g, '').trim() || 'Empty note...';
                const formattedDate = new Date(note.updatedAt || note.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                  month: 'short',
                  day: 'numeric',
                });

                return (
                  <div
                    key={note.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveNoteId(note.id);
                      setMobileEditorOpen(true);
                    }}
                    className={`p-3 cursor-pointer transition-colors relative group ${
                      isActive
                        ? 'bg-white/[0.06] text-white'
                        : 'hover:bg-white/[0.02] text-zinc-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <h3
                        className={`text-xs font-semibold truncate ${
                          isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-zinc-300 group-hover:text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {note.title.trim() || 'Untitled Note'}
                      </h3>
                      {note.isFavorite && (
                        <Star className="w-3 h-3 fill-amber-400 text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 line-clamp-1 mt-1 font-sans">
                      {previewText}
                    </p>

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-600 mt-2">
                      <span>{formattedDate}</span>
                      <span className="text-zinc-500">{note.category}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Clean Distraction-Free Note Canvas */}
        <div
          className={`md:col-span-8 flex-col h-[calc(100dvh-11rem)] md:h-full bg-[#111113] ${
            mobileEditorOpen ? 'flex' : 'hidden md:flex'
          }`}
        >
          {activeNote ? (
            <>
              {/* Document Header Controls */}
              <div className="px-3 sm:px-6 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 select-none">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 min-w-0">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setMobileEditorOpen(false)}
                    className="md:hidden p-2 -ml-2 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors shrink-0"
                    aria-label="Back to notes list"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>

                  {/* Category selector */}
                  <select
                    value={activeNote.category}
                    onChange={(e) => handleCategoryChange(e.target.value)}
                    className="bg-transparent border border-white/[0.08] hover:border-white/[0.2] px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="General" className="bg-[#18181a]">General</option>
                    <option value="Ideas" className="bg-[#18181a]">Ideas</option>
                    <option value="Design" className="bg-[#18181a]">Design</option>

            <div className="divide-y divide-white/[0.04]">
              {recentTools.map((t) => (
                <div key={t.id} className="py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 group">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white group-hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors truncate">
                        {t.title}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500">· {t.category}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 line-clamp-1 mt-0.5">{t.description}</p>
                  </div>

                  {t.url && (
                    <a
                      href={t.url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-colors shrink-0"
                      title="Open link"
                    >
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Notes Section */}
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/[0.06]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
                <span>Recently Edited Notes</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveTab('notes')}
                className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
              >
                <span>All ({notes.length})</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="divide-y divide-white/[0.04]">
              {recentNotes.map((n) => (
                <div
                  key={n.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('notes')}
                  className="py-2.5 cursor-pointer group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white group-hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors truncate">
                      {n.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 shrink-0">
                      {new Date(n.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                        month: 'short',
                        day: 'numeric',
                      })}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 line-clamp-1 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                    {n.content.replace(/[#*`_>]/g, '').slice(0, 75)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import {
  Shield,
  Download,
  Upload,
  RotateCcw,
  Trash2,
  FileJson,
  AlertTriangle,
  Check,
  Wrench,
  FileText,
  Film,
  Cloud,
  HardDrive,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { NavigationTab } from '../../types';
import { fetchStorageUsage, type StorageUsage } from '../../utils/cloudSync';

const FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024;

/** 1.4 MB / 512 MB — short, readable sizes. */
const formatBytes = (bytes: number): string => {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const exponent = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exponent;
  return `${value.toFixed(exponent === 0 ? 0 : value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[exponent]}`;
};

const utf8Bytes = (value: unknown): number =>
  new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value ?? null)).length;

export const SettingsView: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    settings,
    updateSettings,
    tools,
    notes,
    media,
    exportAllJSON,
    exportCollectionJSON,
    importJSON,
    clearAllData,
    resetToSampleData,
    addToast,
    isCloudSyncActive,
    mongoStatus,
  } = useArchive();

  // Import state
  const [importMode, setImportMode] = useState<'merge' | 'replace'>('merge');
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [importSuccess, setImportSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Clear modal state
  const [showClearModal, setShowClearModal] = useState(false);
  const [confirmInput, setConfirmInput] = useState('');

  // Storage allowance against the MongoDB Atlas free plan
  const [storageUsage, setStorageUsage] = useState<StorageUsage | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    fetchStorageUsage().then((usage) => {
      if (mounted) setStorageUsage(usage);
    });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const storage = useMemo(() => {
    if (storageUsage) {
      return {
        usedBytes: storageUsage.usedBytes,
        limitBytes: storageUsage.limitBytes,
        remainingBytes: storageUsage.remainingBytes,
        percentUsed: storageUsage.percentUsed,
        breakdown: storageUsage.breakdown,
        measuredLive: storageUsage.measuredBy === 'atlas-dbstats',
      };
    }

    // Fallback when the API is unreachable: measure the vault saved in this browser.
    const breakdown = [
      { label: 'Tools', bytes: utf8Bytes(tools), count: tools.length },
      { label: 'Notes', bytes: utf8Bytes(notes), count: notes.length },
      { label: 'Watchlist', bytes: utf8Bytes(media), count: media.length },
      { label: 'Settings', bytes: utf8Bytes(settings), count: 1 },
    ];
    const usedBytes = breakdown.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.bytes, 0);

    return {
      usedBytes,
      limitBytes: FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_BYTES,
      remainingBytes: Math.max(0, FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_BYTES - usedBytes),
      percentUsed: (usedBytes / FREE_PLAN_LIMIT_BYTES) * 100,
      breakdown,
      measuredLive: false,
    };
  }, [storageUsage, tools, notes, media, settings]);

  const storageBarWidth = Math.min(
    100,
    Math.max(storage.usedBytes > 0 ? 1 : 0, storage.percentUsed)
  );

  const totalItems = tools.length + notes.length + media.length;

  const handleConfirmToggle = (checked: boolean) => {
    updateSettings({ confirmBeforeDelete: checked });
  };

  const handleDefaultViewChange = (tab: NavigationTab) => {
    updateSettings({ defaultArchiveView: tab });
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setImportError(null);
    setImportSuccess(null);

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const content = event.target?.result as string;
      if (!content) {
        setImportError('File is empty.');
        return;
      }

      const result = importJSON(content, importMode);
      if (result.success) {
        setImportSuccess(result.message);
      } else {
        setImportError(result.message);
      }

      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    };

    reader.onerror = () => {
      setImportError('Failed to read selected file.');
    };

    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const handleExecuteClear = () => {
    if (confirmInput.trim().toUpperCase() === 'CLEAR') {
      clearAllData();
      setShowClearModal(false);
      setConfirmInput('');
    } else {
      addToast('Confirmation Failed', 'error', 'Type CLEAR to confirm deletion.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl animate-in fade-in duration-150 pb-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="pb-4 border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white tracking-tight">
          Settings
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
          Vault preferences and data management for your private archive.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Cloud Sync & Database */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
          <Cloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>Cloud Sync & Database</span>
        </div>

        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span
                className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${
                  isCloudSyncActive ? 'bg-white animate-pulse' : 'bg-zinc-600'
                }`}
              />
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-medium text-white">
                {isCloudSyncActive ? 'Real-Time Cross-Device Sync Active' : 'Offline / Local Mode'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono border border-white/[0.08]">
                {mongoStatus?.isMongoConnected ? 'MongoDB Atlas' : 'Persistent Cloud Store'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
              Synchronizing automatically in the background across browsers and devices with 0ms lag.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-300">Automatic background saving</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">MongoDB Atlas</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Storage Usage vs MongoDB free plan */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
          <HardDrive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>Storage</span>
        </div>

        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500">MongoDB Atlas · M0 free plan</p>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 mt-1">
                <span className="text-2xl font-semibold font-mono tabular-nums text-white">
                  {formatBytes(storage.usedBytes)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500">
                  of {formatBytes(storage.limitBytes)} used
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <span className="shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.04] text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-300 tabular-nums">
              {storage.percentUsed > 0 && storage.percentUsed < 1
                ? '<1%'
                : `${storage.percentUsed.toFixed(1)}%`}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-white/[0.05] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-white/80"
              style={{ width: `${storageBarWidth}%` }}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono">
            <span className="text-zinc-200">
              {formatBytes(storage.remainingBytes)} still available
            </span>
            <span className="text-zinc-500">
              {storage.measuredLive ? 'Live from Atlas' : 'Estimated from saved data'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/[0.06] grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            {storage.breakdown.map((entry) => (
              <div key={entry.label}>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500">
                  {entry.label} <span className="text-zinc-600">({entry.count})</span>
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-200 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                  {formatBytes(entry.bytes)}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 leading-relaxed">
            Atlas M0 clusters include 512 MB of free storage. This covers everything saved in your vault;
            Atlas also counts indexes and cluster overhead.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 1. Vault Preferences Section */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
          <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>Vault Preferences</span>
        </div>

        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
              Default View on Launch
            </label>
            <select
              value={settings.defaultArchiveView}
              onChange={(e) => handleDefaultViewChange(e.target.value as NavigationTab)}
              className="w-full sm:w-64 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30"
            >
              <option value="overview">Overview</option>
              <option value="tools">Tools & Resources</option>
              <option value="notes">Personal Notes</option>
              <option value="watchlist">Watchlist</option>
              <option value="images">Images</option>
              <option value="favorites">Favorites</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Confirm Deletions</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Display safety confirmation dialog before deleting an archive item.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              role="switch"
              aria-checked={settings.confirmBeforeDelete}
              aria-label="Confirm deletions"
              onClick={() => handleConfirmToggle(!settings.confirmBeforeDelete)}
              className={`w-11 h-6 flex items-center rounded-full p-1 transition-colors shrink-0 ${
                settings.confirmBeforeDelete ? 'bg-white' : 'bg-white/[0.1]'
              }`}
            >
              <div
                className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full shadow-sm transform transition-transform ${
                  settings.confirmBeforeDelete ? 'bg-black translate-x-5' : 'bg-zinc-400 translate-x-0'
                }`}
              />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Export Data Section */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
          <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>Export Data</span>
        </div>

        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Complete Archive Snapshot</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Download a clean JSON backup file containing all {totalItems} items.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={exportAllJSON}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 text-xs font-medium transition-colors shrink-0"
            >
              <Download className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Download JSON</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Export Individual Sections */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/[0.06]">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500 mb-2">Export by Section:</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => exportCollectionJSON('tools')}
                className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.02] hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-xs text-zinc-300 hover:text-white border border-white/[0.06] transition-colors font-mono text-[11px]"
              >
                <Wrench className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" />
                <span>Tools JSON</span>
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => exportCollectionJSON('notes')}
                className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.02] hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-xs text-zinc-300 hover:text-white border border-white/[0.06] transition-colors font-mono text-[11px]"
              >
                <FileText className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" />
                <span>Notes JSON</span>
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => exportCollectionJSON('watchlist')}
                className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.02] hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-xs text-zinc-300 hover:text-white border border-white/[0.06] transition-colors font-mono text-[11px]"
              >
                <Film className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" />
                <span>Watchlist JSON</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Import Data Section */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
          <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>Import Data</span>
        </div>

        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Restore from Backup</h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
              Load an existing 0arc JSON file into your active account.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.06]">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">Mode:</span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer text-zinc-200">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="import-mode"
                  checked={importMode === 'merge'}
                  onChange={() => setImportMode('merge')}
                  className="accent-white"
                />
                <span className="text-xs">Merge (keep existing)</span>
              </label>

              <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer text-zinc-200">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="import-mode"
                  checked={importMode === 'replace'}
                  onChange={() => setImportMode('replace')}
                  className="accent-white"
                />
                <span className="text-xs text-zinc-300">Replace All</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef}
              type="file"
              accept=".json,application/json"
              onChange={handleFileUpload}
              className="hidden"
              id="json-file-picker"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.1] text-white border border-white/[0.1] text-xs font-mono transition-colors"
            >
              <FileJson className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
              <span>Select JSON File</span>
            </button>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500">.json snapshots</span>
          </div>

          {importSuccess && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.05] border border-white/[0.12] text-xs text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{importSuccess}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {importError && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-xs text-red-400 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{importError}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Danger Zone Section */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-400">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400" />
          <span>Danger Zone</span>
        </div>

        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4 border-red-500/20">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Reset to Curated Sample Vault</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Restores the standard sample set of tools, notes, and watchlist items.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={resetToSampleData}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.07] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs font-mono text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" />
              <span>Restore Samples</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/[0.06] flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-400">Clear All Vault Data</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Permanently wipes all saved items from your account.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setConfirmInput('');
                setShowClearModal(true);
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/20 text-xs font-mono text-red-400 transition-colors shrink-0"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Erase All</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Clear All Confirmation Modal */}
      {showClearModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="w-full sm:max-w-md surface-elevated border border-red-500/30 rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 pb-[max(1.25rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] sm:pb-6">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 shrink-0">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Erase Vault Data?</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                  This action cannot be undone. All entries in your account will be permanently deleted.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-white/[0.02] rounded-lg border border-white/[0.06]">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                Type <span className="text-red-400 font-bold">CLEAR</span> to confirm:
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={confirmInput}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="CLEAR"
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.1] text-xs font-mono text-white uppercase tracking-wider focus:outline-none focus:border-red-400"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowClearModal(false)}
                className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg transition-colors"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExecuteClear}
                disabled={confirmInput.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'CLEAR'}
                className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 disabled:opacity-40 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              >
                Permanently Erase
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ToolItem, ToolCategory } from '../../types';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface ToolModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  toolToEdit?: ToolItem | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (toolData: Omit<ToolItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => void;
}

export const ToolModal: React.FC<ToolModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  toolToEdit,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ToolCategory>('Development');
  const [tags, setTags] = useState('');
  const [isFavorite, setIsFavorite] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (toolToEdit) {
      setTitle(toolToEdit.title);
      setDescription(toolToEdit.description);
      setUrl(toolToEdit.url || '');
      setCategory(toolToEdit.category);
      setTags(toolToEdit.tags.join(', '));
      setIsFavorite(toolToEdit.isFavorite);
    } else {
      setTitle('');
      setDescription('');
      setUrl('');
      setCategory('Development');
      setTags('');
      setIsFavorite(false);
    }
  }, [toolToEdit, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !description.trim()) return;

    const tagsArray = tags
      .split(',')
      .map((t) => t.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);

    onSave({
      title: title.trim(),
      description: description.trim(),
      url: url.trim() || undefined,
      category,
      tags: tagsArray.length > 0 ? tagsArray : [category.toLowerCase()],
      isFavorite,
    });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg surface-elevated rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] border border-white/[0.08] pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] sm:pb-0">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-white/15 sm:hidden shrink-0" />
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] shrink-0">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white tracking-tight">
            {toolToEdit ? 'Edit Tool' : 'Add Tool'}
          </h2>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-2 -mr-2 rounded-md hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition-colors"
              aria-label="Close"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <form
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4"
        >
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
              Name <span className="text-red-400">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              placeholder="e.g. Cursor, Linear, Raycast"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30 transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
              Description <span className="text-red-400">*</span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              required
              rows={3}
              placeholder="What makes this tool worth archiving?"
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30 resize-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
                URL (optional)
              </label>
              <input
                type="url"
                placeholder="https://..."
                value={url}
                onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
                inputMode="url"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30 transition-colors font-mono sm:text-[11px]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">Category</label>
              <select
                value={category}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as ToolCategory)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30 transition-colors font-mono sm:text-[11px]"
              >
                <option value="AI Tools">AI Tools</option>
                <option value="Development">Development</option>
                <option value="Design">Design</option>
                <option value="Productivity">Productivity</option>
                <option value="Websites">Websites</option>
                <option value="Software">Software</option>
                <option value="Learning">Learning</option>
                <option value="Other">Other</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 mb-1.5">
              Tags (comma separated)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. dev, design, utility"
              value={tags}
              onChange={(e) => setTags(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30 transition-colors font-mono sm:text-[11px]"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              id="tool-modal-fav"
              checked={isFavorite}
              onChange={(e) => setIsFavorite(e.target.checked)}
              className="rounded bg-black/40 border-white/[0.2] accent-white"
            />
            <label htmlFor="tool-modal-fav" className="text-xs text-zinc-300 cursor-pointer select-none">
              Favorite
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-white/[0.06]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg transition-colors"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3.5 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-black bg-white hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-lg transition-colors"
            >
              {toolToEdit ? 'Save Changes' : 'Add Tool'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { ToolItem, ToolCategory } from '../../types';
import { ToolModal } from './ToolModal';
import { ConfirmModal } from '../common/ConfirmModal';
import {
  Plus,
  Search,
  Star,
  ExternalLink,
  MoreVertical,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  Copy,
  LayoutGrid,
  List,
  Wrench,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';

export const ToolsView: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    tools,
    addTool,
    updateTool,
    deleteTool,
    toggleToolFavorite,
    settings,
    addToast,
  } = useArchive();

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [favoritesOnly, setFavoritesOnly] = useState(false);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'newest' | 'oldest' | 'alpha'>('newest');
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list'>('grid');

  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingTool, setEditingTool] = useState<ToolItem | null>(null);
  const [toolToDelete, setToolToDelete] = useState<ToolItem | null>(null);
  const [activeMenuId, setActiveMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const categories: string[] = [
    'All',
    'AI Tools',
    'Development',
    'Design',
    'Productivity',
    'Websites',
    'Software',
    'Learning',
    'Other',
  ];

  const filteredTools = useMemo(() => {
    return tools
      .filter((tool) => {
        const matchesQuery =
          tool.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          tool.tags.some((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()));

        const matchesCategory =
          selectedCategory === 'All' || tool.category === selectedCategory;

        const matchesFavorite = !favoritesOnly || tool.isFavorite;

        return matchesQuery && matchesCategory && matchesFavorite;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === 'newest') {
          return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
        }
        if (sortBy === 'oldest') {
          return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
        }
        if (sortBy === 'alpha') {
          return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [tools, searchQuery, selectedCategory, favoritesOnly, sortBy]);

  const handleCopyLink = (tool: ToolItem) => {
    if (!tool.url) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(tool.url);
    setCopiedId(tool.id);
    addToast('Link Copied', 'info', tool.url);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
    setActiveMenuId(null);
  };

  const handleSaveTool = (toolData: Omit<ToolItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => {
    if (editingTool) {
      updateTool(editingTool.id, toolData);
      setEditingTool(null);
    } else {
      addTool(toolData);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteConfirm = () => {
    if (toolToDelete) {
      deleteTool(toolToDelete.id);
      setToolToDelete(null);
    }
  };

  const getDomainFromUrl = (urlString?: string) => {
    if (!urlString) return null;
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(urlString);
      return parsed.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white tracking-tight">
            Tools & Resources
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
            {tools.length} saved tools, developer utilities, and web bookmarks.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setEditingTool(null);
            setModalOpen(true);
          }}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-zinc-200 text-black text-xs font-medium transition-colors shrink-0"
        >
          <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Add Tool</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
          {/* Search */}
          <div className="relative flex-1">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search tools..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Controls: Favorites, Sort, View Toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={() => setFavoritesOnly((prev) => !prev)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition-colors ${
                favoritesOnly
                  ? 'bg-amber-400/10 border-amber-400/30 text-amber-400'
                  : 'bg-white/[0.03] border-white/[0.08] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Star
                className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${favoritesOnly ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : ''}`}
              />
              <span>Favorites</span>
            </button>

            <select
              value={sortBy}
              onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as 'newest' | 'oldest' | 'alpha')}
              className="px-2.5 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]"
            >
              <option value="newest">Newest</option>
              <option value="oldest">Oldest</option>
              <option value="alpha">Alphabetical</option>
            </select>

            <div className="flex items-center p-0.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08]">
              <button
                onClick={() => setViewMode('grid')}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded text-xs transition-colors ${
                  viewMode === 'grid' ? 'bg-white/[0.1] text-white' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-white'
                }`}
                title="Grid"
              >
                <LayoutGrid className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setViewMode('list')}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded text-xs transition-colors ${
                  viewMode === 'list' ? 'bg-white/[0.1] text-white' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-white'
                }`}
                title="List"
              >
                <List className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Category Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
          {categories.map((cat) => {
            const active = selectedCategory === cat;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-white/[0.1] text-white font-medium border border-white/[0.1]'
                    : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-white/[0.03]'
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content */}
      {filteredTools.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-10 text-center space-y-2">
          <Wrench className="w-6 h-6 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-xs font-medium text-white">No tools found</h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
            Try adjusting your search query or filters.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : viewMode === 'grid' ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filteredTools.map((tool) => {
            const domain = getDomainFromUrl(tool.url);

            return (
              <div
                key={tool.id}
                className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between group relative hover:border-white/[0.15] transition-all"
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Top Bar with Category & Actions */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-2.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      {tool.category}
                    </span>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => toggleToolFavorite(tool.id)}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded text-zinc-500 hover:text-amber-400 transition-colors"
                        title={tool.isFavorite ? 'Unfavorite' : 'Favorite'}
                        aria-label={tool.isFavorite ? 'Unfavorite' : 'Favorite'}
                      >
                        <Star
                          className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${
                            tool.isFavorite ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : ''
                          }`}
                        />
                      </button>

                      <div className="relative">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setActiveMenuId(activeMenuId === tool.id ? null : tool.id)}

                                className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.06]"
                              >

                            <button

                                if (settings.confirmBeforeDelete) {
                                  setToolToDelete(tool);
                                } else {
                                  deleteTool(tool.id);
                                }
                              }}
                              className="w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-red-400 hover:bg-white/[0.06]"

                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );

      ) : (
        /* List View */
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl divide-y divide-white/[0.04] overflow-hidden">
          {filteredTools.map((tool) => (
            <div
              key={tool.id}
              className="p-3.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors group"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-medium shrink-0">
                  {tool.title.charAt(0)}
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                {tool.url && (

                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"

                  aria-label={tool.isFavorite ? 'Unfavorite' : 'Favorite'}

                  className="p-1.5 rounded text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors"
                  title="Delete"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

        isOpen={modalOpen}
        toolToEdit={editingTool}
        onClose={() => {
          setModalOpen(false);
          setEditingTool(null);
        }}
        onSave={handleSaveTool}
      />

        isOpen={Boolean(toolToDelete)}
        title="Delete Tool?"
        description={`Are you sure you want to delete "${toolToDelete?.title}"?`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        onConfirm={handleDeleteConfirm}
        onCancel={() => setToolToDelete(null)}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { Star, Wrench, FileText, Film, ExternalLink, Layers } from 'lucide-react';
import { MediaType, NavigationTab } from '../../types';

const TYPE_LABELS: Record<MediaType, string> = {
  movie: 'Movie',
  series: 'Series',
  anime: 'Anime',
};

interface FavoriteEntry {
  id: string;
  category: 'tool' | 'note' | 'media';
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  description: string;
  url?: string;
  rating?: number;
  createdAt: string;
  targetTab: NavigationTab;
}

export const FavoritesView: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    tools,
    notes,
    media,
    setActiveTab,
    toggleToolFavorite,
    toggleNoteFavorite,
    toggleMediaFavorite,
  } = useArchive();

  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<'all' | 'tool' | 'note' | 'media'>('all');

  const favoritesList: FavoriteEntry[] = useMemo(() => {
    const list: FavoriteEntry[] = [];

    tools
      .filter((t) => t.isFavorite)
      .forEach((t) => {
        list.push({
          id: t.id,
          category: 'tool',
          title: t.title,
          subtitle: `${t.category} · Tool`,
          description: t.description,
          url: t.url,
          createdAt: t.createdAt,
          targetTab: 'tools',
        });
      });

    notes
      .filter((n) => n.isFavorite)
      .forEach((n) => {
        list.push({
          id: n.id,
          category: 'note',
          title: n.title,
          subtitle: `${n.category} · Note`,
          description: n.content.replace(/[#*`_>]/g, '').slice(0, 100),
          createdAt: n.createdAt,
          targetTab: 'notes',
        });
      });

    media
      .filter((m) => m.isFavorite)
      .forEach((m) => {
        list.push({
          id: m.id,
          category: 'media',
          title: m.title,
          subtitle: `${TYPE_LABELS[m.type]} · ${m.genre} (${m.releaseYear})`,
          description: m.description,
          rating: m.rating,
          createdAt: m.createdAt,
          targetTab: 'watchlist',
        });
      });

    return list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }, [tools, notes, media]);

  const filteredFavorites = useMemo(() => {
    if (categoryFilter === 'all') return favoritesList;
    return favoritesList.filter((item) => item.category === categoryFilter);
  }, [favoritesList, categoryFilter]);

  const handleUnfavorite = (e: React.MouseEvent, item: FavoriteEntry) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (item.category === 'tool') toggleToolFavorite(item.id);
    else if (item.category === 'note') toggleNoteFavorite(item.id);
    else if (item.category === 'media') toggleMediaFavorite(item.id);
  };

  const handleOpenItem = (item: FavoriteEntry) => {
    setActiveTab(item.targetTab);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white tracking-tight">
            Favorites
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
            {favoritesList.length} starred items across your archive.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Filter categories */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-0.5 bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] rounded-lg overflow-x-auto self-start sm:self-auto">
          {[
            { id: 'all', label: 'All', icon: <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
            { id: 'tool', label: 'Tools', icon: <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
            { id: 'note', label: 'Notes', icon: <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
            { id: 'media', label: 'Watchlist', icon: <Film className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
          ].map((tab) => {
            const active = categoryFilter === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setCategoryFilter(tab.id as typeof categoryFilter)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-mono whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-white/[0.1] text-white font-medium border border-white/[0.08]'
                    : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'
                }`}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Favorites Feed */}
      {filteredFavorites.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-10 text-center space-y-2">
          <Star className="w-6 h-6 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-xs font-medium text-white">No favorites yet</h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
            Click the star icon on any tool, note, or watchlist item to add it to your favorites.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filteredFavorites.map((item) => {
            const icons = {
              tool: <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />,
              note: <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />,
              media: <Film className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />,
            };

            return (
              <div
                key={`${item.category}-${item.id}`}
                onClick={() => handleOpenItem(item)}
                className="surface-card rounded-xl p-4 group flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer hover:border-white/[0.15] transition-all"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <div className="p-1 rounded bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/[0.06]">
                        {icons[item.category]}
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{item.subtitle}</span>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => handleUnfavorite(e, item)}
                      className="p-1 rounded text-amber-400 hover:opacity-75 transition-opacity"
                      title="Unmark favorite"
                    >
                      <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-amber-400" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white group-hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors truncate">
                    {item.title}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 line-clamp-2 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    {item.description}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3.5 pt-2.5 border-t border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500">
                  <span>
                    {new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                      month: 'short',
                      day: 'numeric',
                    })}
                  </span>

                  {item.rating && (
                    <span className="font-medium text-amber-400">★ {item.rating}/10</span>
                  )}

                  {item.url && (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400">
                      <span>Link</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { MediaItem, MediaType, MediaStatus } from '../../types';
import { lookupMediaDetails, searchMedia, type MediaCandidate } from '../../lib/mediaLookup';
import { X, Search, Loader2, Check, Film } from 'lucide-react';

interface MediaModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  mediaToEdit: MediaItem | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (mediaData: Omit<MediaItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => void;
}

const STATUS_OPTIONS: { value: MediaStatus; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'want_to_watch', label: 'Watchlist' },
  { value: 'watching', label: 'Watching' },
  { value: 'completed', label: 'Completed' },
];

export const MediaModal: React.FC<MediaModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  mediaToEdit,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<MediaStatus>('want_to_watch');
  const [type, setType] = useState<MediaType>('movie');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [posterUrl, setPosterUrl] = useState('');
  const [genre, setGenre] = useState('');
  const [releaseYear, setReleaseYear] = useState<number>(new Date().getFullYear());
  const [rating, setRating] = useState<number>(0);

  const [imdbCandidates, setImdbCandidates] = useState<MediaCandidate[]>([]);
  const [isSearchingImdb, setIsSearchingImdb] = useState(false);
  const [showCandidates, setShowCandidates] = useState(false);
  const [isLoadingDetails, setIsLoadingDetails] = useState(false);
  const searchTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mediaToEdit) return;
    setTitle(mediaToEdit.title);
    setStatus(mediaToEdit.status);
    setType(mediaToEdit.type);
    setDescription(mediaToEdit.description);
    setPosterUrl(mediaToEdit.posterUrl || '');
    setGenre(mediaToEdit.genre);
    setReleaseYear(mediaToEdit.releaseYear);
    setRating(mediaToEdit.rating);
    setImdbCandidates([]);
    setShowCandidates(false);
  }, [mediaToEdit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (searchTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!isOpen || !mediaToEdit) return null;

  const performImdbSearch = async (query: string) => {
    setIsSearchingImdb(true);
    try {
      const results = await searchMedia(query, type);
      setImdbCandidates(results);
      setShowCandidates(results.length > 0);
    } catch {
      setImdbCandidates([]);
    } finally {
      setIsSearchingImdb(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTitleChange = (value: string) => {
    setTitle(value);
    if (searchTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(searchTimerRef.current);
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed.length >= 2) {
      searchTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        performImdbSearch(trimmed);
      }, 350);
    } else {
      setImdbCandidates([]);
      setShowCandidates(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectCandidate = async (candidate: MediaCandidate) => {
    const chosenTitle = candidate.title;
    setTitle(chosenTitle);
    setType(candidate.type);
    if (candidate.year) setReleaseYear(candidate.year);
    if (candidate.posterUrl) setPosterUrl(candidate.posterUrl);
    setShowCandidates(false);

    const detailsOrUndefined = await fillMediaFieldsFromApi(
      chosenTitle,
      candidate.type,
      candidate.posterUrl,
      candidate.id
    );
    if (detailsOrUndefined) {
      if (detailsOrUndefined.description) setDescription(detailsOrUndefined.description);
      if (detailsOrUndefined.posterUrl) setPosterUrl(detailsOrUndefined.posterUrl);
      if (detailsOrUndefined.genre) setGenre(detailsOrUndefined.genre);
      if (detailsOrUndefined.releaseYear) setReleaseYear(Number(detailsOrUndefined.releaseYear));
      if (detailsOrUndefined.rating) setRating(Number(detailsOrUndefined.rating));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanTitle = title.trim();
    if (!cleanTitle) return;

    let finalDesc = description.trim();
    let finalPoster = posterUrl.trim();

    if (!finalDesc || !finalPoster) {
      const fillResult = await fillMediaFieldsFromApi(cleanTitle, type, posterUrl);
      if (fillResult?.description) finalDesc = fillResult.description;
      if (fillResult?.posterUrl) finalPoster = fillResult.posterUrl;
      if (fillResult?.genre && !genre.trim()) setGenre(fillResult.genre);
      if (fillResult?.releaseYear) setReleaseYear(Number(fillResult.releaseYear));
      if (fillResult?.rating) setRating(Number(fillResult.rating));
    }

    onSave({
      title: cleanTitle,
      type,
      status,
      description: finalDesc || 'Saved to your watchlist.',
      posterUrl: finalPoster || undefined,
      genre: genre.trim() || 'Uncategorized',
      releaseYear: releaseYear || new Date().getFullYear(),
      rating: rating || 0,
      isFavorite: mediaToEdit.isFavorite,
    });
    onClose();
  };

  const inputClass =
    'w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.08] text-sm text-white placeholder-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/30 transition-colors';

  const fillMediaFieldsFromApi = async (
    title: string,
    type: MediaType,
    existingPoster?: string,
    imdbId?: string
  ) => {
    setIsLoadingDetails(true);
    try {
      return await lookupMediaDetails({
        title,
        type,
        posterUrl: existingPoster || undefined,
        imdbId,
      });
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingDetails(false);
    }
  };


  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg surface-elevated rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] border border-white/[0.08] pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] sm:pb-0">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-white/15 sm:hidden shrink-0" />

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] shrink-0">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Edit entry</h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-2 -mr-2 rounded-md hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition-colors"
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col">

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useArchive } from '../../context/ArchiveContext';
import { MediaItem, MediaStatus } from '../../types';
import { MediaModal } from './MediaModal';

const STATUS_LABELS: Partial<Record<MediaStatus, string>> = {
  want_to_watch: 'Watchlist',
  watching: 'Watching',
  completed: 'Completed',
};

const TYPE_LABELS: Record<MediaItem['type'], string> = {
  movie: 'Movie',
  series: 'Series',
  anime: 'Anime',
};

export const WatchlistView: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    media,
    updateMedia,
    deleteMedia,
    toggleMediaFavorite,
    openQuickAdd,
    settings,
  } = useArchive();

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<'all' | MediaStatus>('all');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<'all' | MediaItem['type']>('all');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'recent' | 'rating' | 'year' | 'alpha'>('recent');
  const [favoritesOnly, setFavoritesOnly] = useState(false);

  const [selectedMedia, setSelectedMedia] = useState<MediaItem | null>(null);
  const [editingMedia, setEditingMedia] = useState<MediaItem | null>(null);
  const [mediaToDelete, setMediaToDelete] = useState<MediaItem | null>(null);

  const filteredMedia = useMemo(() => {
    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

    return media
      .filter((item) => {
        const matchesQuery =
          !query ||
          item.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          item.genre.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          item.description.toLowerCase().includes(query);

        const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || item.status === statusFilter;
        const matchesType = typeFilter === 'all' || item.type === typeFilter;
        const matchesFavorite = !favoritesOnly || item.isFavorite;

        return matchesQuery && matchesStatus && matchesType && matchesFavorite;
      });
  }, [media, searchQuery, statusFilter, typeFilter, sortBy, favoritesOnly]);

  const handleSaveMedia = (mediaData: Omit<MediaItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>) => {
    if (!editingMedia) return;
    updateMedia(editingMedia.id, mediaData);
    setEditingMedia(null);
  };

  const handleDeleteConfirm = () => {
    if (!mediaToDelete) return;
    deleteMedia(mediaToDelete.id);
    if (selectedMedia?.id === mediaToDelete.id) setSelectedMedia(null);
    setMediaToDelete(null);
  };

  const selectClass =
    'px-2.5 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white tracking-tight">Watchlist</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
            {media.length} {media.length === 1 ? 'title' : 'titles'} you want to watch or are
            watching.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => openQuickAdd('watchlist')}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-zinc-200 text-black text-xs font-medium transition-colors shrink-0"
        >
          <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>Add</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Search + filters */}
      <div className="space-y-2.5">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
          <input
            type="search"
            placeholder="Search titles, genres..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] text-sm sm:text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/[0.2]"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:flex sm:items-center gap-2">
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value as 'all' | MediaStatus)}
            className={selectClass}
            aria-label="Filter by status"
          >
            <option value="all">All statuses</option>
            {(Object.keys(STATUS_LABELS) as MediaStatus[]).map((status) => (
              <option key={status} value={status}>
                {STATUS_LABELS[status]}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <select
            value={typeFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setTypeFilter(e.target.value as 'all' | MediaItem['type'])}
            className={selectClass}
            aria-label="Filter by media type"
          >
            <option value="all">All types</option>
            <option value="movie">Movies</option>
            <option value="series">Series</option>
            <option value="anime">Anime</option>
          </select>

          <select
            value={sortBy}
            onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as 'recent' | 'rating' | 'year' | 'alpha')}
            className={selectClass}
            aria-label="Sort watchlist"
          >
            <option value="recent">Recent</option>
            <option value="rating">Highest rated</option>
            <option value="year">Release year</option>
