          </select>

          <button
            onClick={() => setFavoritesOnly((prev) => !prev)}
            className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 sm:py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs transition-colors col-span-2 sm:col-span-1 sm:w-auto ${
              favoritesOnly
                ? 'bg-amber-400/10 border-amber-400/30 text-amber-400'
                : 'bg-white/[0.03] border-white/[0.08] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
            aria-pressed={favoritesOnly}
          >
            <Star className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${favoritesOnly ? 'fill-amber-400' : ''}`} />
            <span>Favorites</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      {filteredMedia.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="surface-card rounded-xl p-10 text-center space-y-2">
          <Film className="w-6 h-6 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-xs font-medium text-white">
            {media.length === 0 ? 'Your watchlist is empty' : 'No titles found'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
            {media.length === 0
              ? 'Press “Add” to save your first movie, series, or anime.'
              : 'Try a different search or filter.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
          {filteredMedia.map((item, index) => {
            return (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedMedia(item)}
                role="button"
                tabIndex={0}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setSelectedMedia(item);
                  }
                }}
                className="surface-card rounded-xl overflow-hidden group flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer relative hover:border-white/[0.15] transition-all focus:outline-none focus-visible:border-white/30"
              >
                <div className="aspect-[2/3] w-full bg-[#0c0c0e] relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
                  {item.posterUrl ? (
                    <img
                      src={item.posterUrl}
                      alt={item.title}
                      loading={index < 4 ? 'eager' : 'lazy'}
                      decoding="async"
                      fetchPriority={index < 2 ? 'high' : 'auto'}
                      referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="p-4 text-center text-zinc-600 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase">
                      {TYPE_LABELS[item.type]}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0c0c0d] via-transparent to-black/40 pointer-events-none" />

                  {item.rating > 0 && (
                    <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/[0.1] text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-amber-400">
                      ★ {item.rating}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      toggleMediaFavorite(item.id);
                    }}
                    className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 p-2 rounded-lg bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/[0.08] text-zinc-400 hover:text-amber-400 transition-colors"
                    aria-label={item.isFavorite ? 'Remove from favorites' : 'Add to favorites'}
                  >
                    <Star
                      className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${
                        item.isFavorite ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : ''
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>

                  <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 right-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono">
                    <span className="text-zinc-300 truncate font-medium">
                      {STATUS_LABELS[item.status] || 'Watchlist'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-500 shrink-0">{item.releaseYear}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white truncate">{item.title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                    {TYPE_LABELS[item.type]}
                    {item.genre ? ` · ${item.genre}` : ''}
                  </p>

                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <MediaDetailModal
        media={selectedMedia}
        onClose={() => setSelectedMedia(null)}
        onEdit={(item) => {
          setSelectedMedia(null);
          setEditingMedia(item);
        }}
        onDelete={(item) => {

          onUpdateType={(id, type) => {

      <MediaModal

        mediaToEdit={editingMedia}
        onClose={() => setEditingMedia(null)}
        onSave={handleSaveMedia}
      />

      <ConfirmModal
        isOpen={Boolean(mediaToDelete)}
        title="Remove title?"
        description={`Are you sure you want to remove "${mediaToDelete?.title}" from your watchlist?`}
        confirmLabel="Remove"
        onConfirm={handleDeleteConfirm}
        onCancel={() => setMediaToDelete(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );

const ArchiveContext = createContext<ArchiveContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const STORAGE_PREFIX = '0arc_vault';

const generateUUID = (): string => {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
    const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return v.toString(16);
  });
};

const optimizePosterUrl = (url: string): string => {
  if (!url) return url;
  return url
    .replace('/w92/', '/w342/')
    .replace('/w154/', '/w342/')
    .replace('/w185/', '/w342/')
    .replace('/w342/', '/w342/')
    .replace('/w500/', '/w342/')
    .replace('/w780/', '/w500/');
};

const normalizeMediaStatus = (status?: string): MediaStatus => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'watching':
    case 'reading':
      return 'watching';
    case 'completed':
    case 'watched':
      return 'completed';
    case 'on_hold':
      return 'on_hold';
    case 'dropped':
      return 'dropped';
    default:
      return 'want_to_watch';
  }
};

const normalizeMediaItems = (items: unknown): MediaItem[] => {
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
  return items
    .filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => Boolean(item) && typeof item === 'object')
    .filter((item) => item.type !== 'manga')
    .map((item) => ({
      id: String(item.id || generateUUID()),
      title: String(item.title || 'Untitled'),
      type: item.type === 'series' || item.type === 'anime' ? item.type : 'movie',
      posterUrl: (() => {
        const poster =
          typeof item.posterUrl === 'string'
            ? item.posterUrl
            : typeof item.poster_url === 'string'
              ? item.poster_url
              : '';
        return poster ? optimizePosterUrl(poster) : undefined;
      })(),
      description: String(item.description || ''),
      genre: String(item.genre || ''),
      releaseYear: Number(item.releaseYear || item.release_year) || new Date().getFullYear(),
      rating: Number(item.rating) || 0,
      status: normalizeMediaStatus(typeof item.status === 'string' ? item.status : undefined),
      notes: typeof item.notes === 'string' ? item.notes : undefined,
      progressCurrent: Number(item.progressCurrent ?? item.progress_current ?? 0),
      progressTotal: Number(item.progressTotal ?? item.progress_total ?? 0),
      isFavorite: Boolean(item.isFavorite ?? item.is_favorite),
      createdAt: String(item.createdAt || item.created_at || new Date().toISOString()),
      updatedAt: String(item.updatedAt || item.updated_at || new Date().toISOString()),
    }));
};

export const ArchiveProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // Single-owner account (no login barrier required for personal archive)
  const currentUser: UserAccount = {
    id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    username: 'owner',
    createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
  };

  // Client ID for this browser tab/session to avoid echoing back own edits in SSE
  const clientIdRef = useRef<string>(
    typeof window !== 'undefined'
      ? (() => {
          let id = sessionStorage.getItem('0arc_client_id');
          if (!id) {
            id = `device-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
            sessionStorage.setItem('0arc_client_id', id);
          }
          return id;
        })()
      : 'device-server'
  );

  // Synchronously seed from localStorage for instantaneous 0ms display
  const [tools, setTools] = useState<ToolItem[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_tools`);
      return stored ? (JSON.parse(stored) as ToolItem[]) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<NoteItem[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_notes`);
      return stored ? (JSON.parse(stored) as NoteItem[]) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  const [media, setMedia] = useState<MediaItem[]>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_media`);
      return stored ? normalizeMediaItems(JSON.parse(stored)) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<AppSettings>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_settings`);
      return stored ? { ...INITIAL_SETTINGS, ...JSON.parse(stored) } : INITIAL_SETTINGS;
    } catch {
      return INITIAL_SETTINGS;
    }
  });

  const [activeTab, setActiveTabState] = useState<NavigationTab>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const routedTab = tabFromPath(window.location.pathname);
      if (routedTab) return routedTab;
    }
    const fallback = settings.defaultArchiveView;
    // Settings has no URL of its own, so a launch page can never be Settings.
    return fallback && fallback !== 'settings' ? fallback : 'overview';
  });
  const [searchModalOpen, setSearchModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [quickAddModalOpen, setQuickAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [quickAddInitialType, setQuickAddInitialType] = useState<ArchiveCategory | null>(null);
  const [cloudModalOpen, setCloudModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastMessage[]>([]);

  // Cloud Sync State
  const [isCloudSyncActive, setIsCloudSyncActive] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [cloudSyncStatus, setCloudSyncStatus] = useState<'synced' | 'syncing' | 'local' | 'error'>('synced');
  const [mongoStatus, setMongoStatus] = useState<MongoStatus | null>(null);

  /**
   * Switch sections and mirror them into the address bar, so every routed tab
   * (`/tools`, `/notes`, `/watchlist`, `/images`, `/favorites`) is bookmarkable.
   */
  const setActiveTab = useCallback((tab: NavigationTab) => {
    setActiveTabState(tab);
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const path = pathForTab(tab);
    if (normalizePath(window.location.pathname) !== path) {
      window.history.pushState({ tab }, '', path);
    }
  }, []);

  // Canonicalize the first paint: deep links stay, unknown paths go home.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const path = pathForTab(activeTab);
    if (normalizePath(window.location.pathname) !== path) {
      window.history.replaceState({ tab: activeTab }, '', path);
    }
    // Only the landing URL needs normalizing.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // Browser back/forward navigation follows the URL.
  useEffect(() => {
    const handlePopState = () => {
      const routedTab = tabFromPath(window.location.pathname);
      if (routedTab) {
        setActiveTabState(routedTab);
      } else {
        window.history.replaceState({ tab: 'overview' }, '', '/');
        setActiveTabState('overview');
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
  }, []);

  // Keep the document title in step with the active section.
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = activeTab === 'overview' ? '0arc — Personal Digital Archive' : `${TAB_TITLES[activeTab]} — 0arc`;
  }, [activeTab]);

  // Flags to avoid sync loops
  const isInitialCloudLoadDoneRef = useRef(false);
  const isApplyingRemoteUpdateRef = useRef(false);
  const syncTimeoutRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const addToast = useCallback(
    (title: string, type: ToastMessage['type'] = 'info', message?: string) => {
      const id = `toast-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
      const newToast: ToastMessage = { id, title, type, message };
      setToasts((prev) => [...prev, newToast]);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
      }, 3500);
    },
    []
  );

  const dismissToast = (id: string) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  };

  /**
   * Hydrate local cache with data fetched from the cloud server.
   */
  const applyCloudSnapshot = useCallback((data: CloudVaultPayload) => {
    isApplyingRemoteUpdateRef.current = true;

    if (Array.isArray(data.tools)) {
      setTools(data.tools);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_tools`, JSON.stringify(data.tools));
      } catch {}
    }

    if (Array.isArray(data.notes)) {
      setNotes(data.notes);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_notes`, JSON.stringify(data.notes));
      } catch {}
    }

    if (Array.isArray(data.media)) {
      const normMedia = normalizeMediaItems(data.media);
      setMedia(normMedia);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_media`, JSON.stringify(normMedia));
      } catch {}
    }

    if (data.settings && typeof data.settings === 'object') {
      const normSettings = { ...INITIAL_SETTINGS, ...data.settings };
      setSettings(normSettings);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_settings`, JSON.stringify(normSettings));
      } catch {}
    }

    setCloudSyncStatus('synced');
    setIsCloudSyncActive(true);

    // Release flag after state update settles
    setTimeout(() => {
      isApplyingRemoteUpdateRef.current = false;
    }, 100);
  }, []);

  /**
   * On startup, fetch current vault data from cloud and query MongoDB status.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    async function initialSync() {
      // 1. Check MongoDB status
      fetchMongoStatus().then((status) => {
        if (mounted) setMongoStatus(status);
      });

      // 2. Fetch cloud data
      const res = await fetchCloudVault();
      if (!mounted) return;

      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        const cloudData = res.data;
        const localToolsEmpty = tools.length === 0;
        const localNotesEmpty = notes.length === 0;
        const localMediaEmpty = media.length === 0;

        const cloudHasData =
          (cloudData.tools && cloudData.tools.length > 0) ||
          (cloudData.notes && cloudData.notes.length > 0) ||
          (cloudData.media && cloudData.media.length > 0);

        if (cloudHasData || (localToolsEmpty && localNotesEmpty && localMediaEmpty)) {
          // Cloud has content (or local is empty), apply cloud state
          applyCloudSnapshot(cloudData);
        } else if (!cloudHasData && (!localToolsEmpty || !localNotesEmpty || !localMediaEmpty)) {
          // First time migrating local browser data up to the cloud!
          const migrationResult = await pushCloudVault(clientIdRef.current, {
            tools,
            notes,
            media,
            settings,
          });
          if (migrationResult.ok) {
            setCloudSyncStatus('synced');
          } else {
            setCloudSyncStatus('error');
          }
        }
      }

      isInitialCloudLoadDoneRef.current = true;
    }

    initialSync();

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, [applyCloudSnapshot]);

  /**
   * Real-Time Synchronization Listener via SSE:
   * Keeps every open device and browser synchronized with zero lag.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = setupRealtimeSync(
      clientIdRef.current,
      (remoteUpdate) => {
        // Silently update without interrupting user with notifications
        applyCloudSnapshot(remoteUpdate);
      },
      (status) => {
        if (status === 'connected') {
          setIsCloudSyncActive(true);
          setCloudSyncStatus('synced');
        } else if (status === 'reconnecting') {
          setCloudSyncStatus('syncing');
        }
      }
    );

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [applyCloudSnapshot]);

  /**
   * Background sync: When user changes items or settings, save to localStorage
   * immediately (0ms lag) and debounce save to cloud server in background.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Dual-write to localStorage instantly
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_tools`, JSON.stringify(tools));
      localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_notes`, JSON.stringify(notes));
      localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_media`, JSON.stringify(media));
      localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_PREFIX}_settings`, JSON.stringify(settings));
    } catch {}

    // If change was triggered by remote incoming update, don't re-upload
    if (isApplyingRemoteUpdateRef.current) return;
    if (!isInitialCloudLoadDoneRef.current) return;

    // Debounce cloud push to batch rapid typing/drag-drops cleanly
    if (syncTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(syncTimeoutRef.current);
    }

    syncTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
      setCloudSyncStatus('syncing');
      const result = await pushCloudVault(clientIdRef.current, {
        tools,
        notes,
        media,
        settings,
      });
      setCloudSyncStatus(result.ok ? 'synced' : 'error');
    }, 350);

    return () => {
      if (syncTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(syncTimeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, [tools, notes, media, settings]);

  /**
   * Hotkeys (Command+K search, 1-6 tab switching, C for quick add)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const isInput =
        target &&
        (target.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
          target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
          target.isContentEditable);

      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSearchModalOpen((prev) => !prev);
        return;
      }

      if (isInput) return;

      if (e.key === 'c' || e.key === 'C') {
        if (!e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setQuickAddInitialType(null);
          setQuickAddModalOpen(true);
        }
      } else if (e.key === '1') {
        setActiveTab('overview');
      } else if (e.key === '2') {
        setActiveTab('tools');
      } else if (e.key === '3') {
        setActiveTab('notes');
      } else if (e.key === '4') {
        setActiveTab('watchlist');
      } else if (e.key === '5') {
        setActiveTab('favorites');
      } else if (e.key === '6') {
        setActiveTab('settings');
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Auth stubs (single user archive)
  const login = async () => ({ success: true });
  const register = async () => ({ success: true });
  const logout = () => {};

  // Cloud actions
  const forceCloudSync = async () => {
    setCloudSyncStatus('syncing');
    const res = await pushCloudVault(clientIdRef.current, {
      tools,
      notes,
      media,
      settings,
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      setCloudSyncStatus('synced');
      addToast('Cloud Synchronized', 'success', 'All changes synchronized across your devices.');
    } else {
      setCloudSyncStatus('error');
      addToast('Sync Failed', 'error', res.error || 'Could not reach cloud server.');
    }
  };

  const connectMongoAtlas = async (uri: string) => {
    const res = await setMongoConnection(uri);
    if (res.ok) {
      const status = await fetchMongoStatus();
      setMongoStatus(status);
      addToast('Connected to MongoDB Atlas', 'success', 'Real-time database active and synchronized.');
    } else {
      addToast('MongoDB Connection Error', 'error', res.message || 'Failed to connect.');
    }
    return res;
  };

  const disconnectMongoAtlas = async () => {
    await setMongoConnection('');
    const status = await fetchMongoStatus();
    setMongoStatus(status);
    addToast('Disconnected from MongoDB', 'info', 'Reverted to built-in cloud persistence.');
  };

  const openCloudModal = () => setCloudModalOpen(true);
  const closeCloudModal = () => setCloudModalOpen(false);

  // Backwards compatibility stubs
  const connectCloud = async () => forceCloudSync();
  const disconnectCloud = () => {
    setIsCloudSyncActive(false);
    setCloudSyncStatus('local');
    addToast('Cloud Sync Paused', 'info');
  };
  const updateCloud = async () => forceCloudSync();
  const connectSupabase = async () => ({ success: true });
  const disconnectSupabase = () => {};

  const openSearchModal = () => setSearchModalOpen(true);
  const closeSearchModal = () => setSearchModalOpen(false);

  const openQuickAdd = (type?: ArchiveCategory) => {
    setQuickAddInitialType(type || null);
    setQuickAddModalOpen(true);
  };
  const closeQuickAdd = () => {
    setQuickAddModalOpen(false);
    setQuickAddInitialType(null);
  };

  // ---------- CRUD OPERATIONS (Optimistic UI, 0ms lag) ----------

  const addTool = (toolData: Omit<ToolItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): ToolItem => {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const newTool: ToolItem = {
      ...toolData,
      id: generateUUID(),
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    setTools((prev) => [newTool, ...prev]);
    addToast('Tool Saved', 'success', `"${newTool.title}" saved.`);
    return newTool;
  };

  const updateTool = (id: string, updates: Partial<ToolItem>) => {
    setTools((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, ...updates, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : item
      )
    );
    addToast('Tool Updated', 'info');
  };

  const deleteTool = (id: string) => {
    const item = tools.find((t) => t.id === id);
    setTools((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    addToast('Tool Removed', 'info', item ? `"${item.title}" removed.` : undefined);
  };

  const toggleToolFavorite = (id: string) => {
    setTools((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id
          ? { ...item, isFavorite: !item.isFavorite, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          : item
      )
    );
  };

  const addNote = (noteData: Omit<NoteItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): NoteItem => {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const newNote: NoteItem = {
      ...noteData,
      id: generateUUID(),
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    setNotes((prev) => [newNote, ...prev]);
    addToast('Note Created', 'success', `"${newNote.title}" saved.`);
    return newNote;
  };

  const updateNote = (id: string, updates: Partial<NoteItem>) => {
    setNotes((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, ...updates, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : item
      )
    );
  };

  const deleteNote = (id: string) => {
    const item = notes.find((n) => n.id === id);
    setNotes((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
    addToast('Note Deleted', 'info', item ? `"${item.title}" deleted.` : undefined);
  };

  const duplicateNote = (id: string): NoteItem => {
    const target = notes.find((n) => n.id === id);
    if (!target) throw new Error('Note not found');
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const duplicated: NoteItem = {
      ...target,
      id: generateUUID(),
      title: `${target.title} (Copy)`,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    setNotes((prev) => [duplicated, ...prev]);
    addToast('Note Duplicated', 'success', `Created copy of "${target.title}".`);
    return duplicated;
  };

  const toggleNoteFavorite = (id: string) => {
    setNotes((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id
          ? { ...item, isFavorite: !item.isFavorite, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          : item
      )
    );
  };

  const addMedia = (mediaData: Omit<MediaItem, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): MediaItem => {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const newMedia: MediaItem = {
      ...mediaData,
      id: generateUUID(),
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    setMedia((prev) => [newMedia, ...prev]);
    addToast('Added to Watchlist', 'success', `"${newMedia.title}" saved.`);
    return newMedia;
  };

  const updateMedia = (id: string, updates: Partial<MediaItem>) => {
    setMedia((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, ...updates, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : item
      )
    );
    addToast('Watchlist Updated', 'info');
  };

  const deleteMedia = (id: string) => {
    const item = media.find((m) => m.id === id);
    setMedia((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
    addToast('Item Removed', 'info', item ? `"${item.title}" removed.` : undefined);
  };

  const updateMediaProgress = (id: string, current: number, total?: number) => {
    setMedia((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const newCurrent = Math.max(0, current);
          const newTotal = total !== undefined ? total : item.progressTotal;
          let newStatus = item.status;
          if (newTotal && newCurrent >= newTotal && newStatus === 'watching') {
            newStatus = 'completed';
          }
          return {
            ...item,
            progressCurrent: newCurrent,
            progressTotal: newTotal,
            status: newStatus,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const toggleMediaFavorite = (id: string) => {
    setMedia((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id
          ? { ...item, isFavorite: !item.isFavorite, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          : item
      )
    );
  };

  const updateSettings = (updates: Partial<AppSettings>) => {
    setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updates }));
    addToast('Preferences Saved', 'success');
  };

  const exportAllJSON = async () => {
    const snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot = {
      version: '1.0.0',
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      tools,
      notes,
      media,
      settings,
      gallery: await exportGalleryImages(),
    };
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `0arc-backup-${dateStr}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    addToast('Export Complete', 'success', 'All vault data downloaded.');
  };

  const exportCollectionJSON = async (category: ArchiveCategory) => {
    let data: unknown = [];
    if (category === 'tools') data = tools;
    if (category === 'notes') data = notes;
    if (category === 'watchlist') data = media;

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `0arc-${category}-${dateStr}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    addToast(`${category.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + category.slice(1)} Exported`, 'success');
  };

  const importJSON = (jsonString: string, mode: 'merge' | 'replace') => {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString);
      let importedTools: ToolItem[] = [];
      let importedNotes: NoteItem[] = [];
      let importedMedia: MediaItem[] = [];

      if (parsed.version && (parsed.tools || parsed.notes || parsed.media)) {
        importedTools = Array.isArray(parsed.tools) ? parsed.tools : [];
        importedNotes = Array.isArray(parsed.notes) ? parsed.notes : [];
        importedMedia = normalizeMediaItems(parsed.media);
      } else if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        const sample = parsed[0];
        if (!sample) return { success: false, message: 'JSON array is empty.' };
        if ('category' in sample && 'url' in sample) {
          importedTools = parsed as ToolItem[];
        } else if ('content' in sample) {
          importedNotes = parsed as NoteItem[];
        } else if ('type' in sample && 'genre' in sample) {
          importedMedia = normalizeMediaItems(parsed);
        } else {
          return { success: false, message: 'Unrecognized archive data structure.' };
        }
      } else {
        return { success: false, message: 'Invalid 0arc JSON archive format.' };
      }

      if (mode === 'replace') {
        if (importedTools.length) setTools(importedTools);
        if (importedNotes.length) setNotes(importedNotes);
        if (importedMedia.length) setMedia(importedMedia);
      } else {
        if (importedTools.length) {
          setTools((prev) => {
            const existingIds = new Set(prev.map((t) => t.id));
            const fresh = importedTools.filter((t) => !existingIds.has(t.id));
            return [...fresh, ...prev];
          });
        }
        if (importedNotes.length) {
          setNotes((prev) => {
            const existingIds = new Set(prev.map((n) => n.id));
            const fresh = importedNotes.filter((n) => !existingIds.has(n.id));
            return [...fresh, ...prev];
          });
        }
        if (importedMedia.length) {
          setMedia((prev) => {
            const existingIds = new Set(prev.map((m) => m.id));
            const fresh = importedMedia.filter((m) => !existingIds.has(m.id));
            return [...fresh, ...prev];
          });
        }
      }

      const count = importedTools.length + importedNotes.length + importedMedia.length;
      addToast('Import Successful', 'success', `Imported ${count} items.`);
      return { success: true, message: `Successfully imported ${count} items.` };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Invalid JSON file format';
      addToast('Import Failed', 'error', errMsg);
      return { success: false, message: errMsg };
    }
  };

  const clearAllData = () => {
    setTools([]);
    setNotes([]);
    setMedia([]);
    addToast('Vault Cleared', 'warning', 'All archive entries have been erased.');
  };

  const resetToSampleData = () => {
    setTools([]);
    setNotes([]);
    setMedia([]);
    setSettings(INITIAL_SETTINGS);
    addToast('Vault Reset', 'info', 'Reset to an empty vault.');
  };

  return (
    <ArchiveContext.Provider
      value={{
        currentUser,
        login,
        register,
        logout,
        tools,
        notes,
        media,
        settings,
        activeTab,
        setActiveTab,
        searchModalOpen,
        openSearchModal,
        closeSearchModal,
        quickAddModalOpen,
        quickAddInitialType,
        openQuickAdd,
        closeQuickAdd,
        addTool,
        updateTool,
        deleteTool,
        toggleToolFavorite,
        addNote,

import type { MediaType } from '../types';

export interface MediaCandidate {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  year?: number;
  type: MediaType;
  rawType?: string;
  posterUrl?: string;
  stars?: string;
}

export interface MediaDetails {
  title: string;
  type: MediaType;
  description: string;
  genre: string;
  releaseYear: number;
  rating: number;
  posterUrl: string;
  progressTotal?: number;
}

export async function searchMedia(query: string, type?: MediaType): Promise<MediaCandidate[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ q: query.trim() });
  if (type) params.set('type', type);
  const response = await fetch(`/api/imdb/search?${params.toString()}`);
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
    | { ok?: boolean; results?: MediaCandidate[]; error?: string }
    | null;

  if (!response.ok || payload?.ok === false) {
    throw new Error(payload?.error || 'Search is temporarily unavailable');
  }

  return Array.isArray(payload?.results) ? payload.results : [];
}

export async function lookupMediaDetails(input: {
  title: string;
  year?: number;
  type?: MediaType;
  imdbId?: string;
  posterUrl?: string;
}): Promise<MediaDetails | null> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/imdb/details', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(input),
  });
  if (!response.ok) return null;
  return (await response.json()) as MediaDetails;
}

import { NavigationTab } from '../types';

/**
 * Human-readable URLs for the archive sections.
 *
 * Home/Overview stays at `/` and Settings intentionally has no path of its own —
 * it is reached from the nav and keeps the current URL untouched (the router
 * simply parks it on `/`).
 */
export const TAB_PATHS: Record<NavigationTab, string> = {
  overview: '/',
  ai: '/ai',
  tools: '/tools',
  notes: '/notes',
  watchlist: '/watchlist',
  images: '/images',
  favorites: '/favorites',
  settings: '/',
};

export const TAB_TITLES: Record<NavigationTab, string> = {
  overview: 'Overview',
  ai: 'AI',
  tools: 'Tools',
  notes: 'Notes',
  watchlist: 'Watchlist',
  images: 'Images',
  favorites: 'Favorites',
  settings: 'Settings',
};

const PATH_TO_TAB: Record<string, NavigationTab> = {
  '/': 'overview',
  '/ai': 'ai',
  '/tools': 'tools',
  '/notes': 'notes',
  '/watchlist': 'watchlist',
  '/images': 'images',
  '/favorites': 'favorites',
};

/** Lower-case, strip trailing slashes so `/Tools/` still resolves. */
export function normalizePath(pathname: string): string {
  const trimmed = (pathname || '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return (trimmed === '' ? '/' : trimmed).toLowerCase();
}

export function tabFromPath(pathname: string): NavigationTab | null {
  return PATH_TO_TAB[normalizePath(pathname)] ?? null;
}

export function pathForTab(tab: NavigationTab): string {
  return TAB_PATHS[tab] ?? '/';
}

export interface CloudVaultPayload {

  ok: boolean;
  isMongoConnected: boolean;
  hasCustomMongo: boolean;
  mongoUriMasked?: string;
  storageType: string;

  label: string;
  bytes: number;
  count: number;

export interface StorageUsage {
  ok: boolean;

  limitBytes: number;
  remainingBytes: number;

/**
 * Measure the vault against the MongoDB Atlas free plan allowance.
 */
export async function fetchStorageUsage(): Promise<StorageUsage | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/cloud/storage-usage');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const json = (await res.json()) as StorageUsage;
    if (json.ok === false) return null;
    return json;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch the latest vault snapshot from the cloud server.
 */
export async function fetchCloudVault(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  data?: CloudVaultPayload;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/cloud/data');
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }
    const json = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; data?: CloudVaultPayload; error?: string };
    if (json.ok === false || !json.data) {
      return { ok: false, error: json.error || 'Cloud vault is unavailable' };
    }
    return { ok: true, data: json.data };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch cloud vault',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Push updated vault data to the cloud in the background.
 */
export async function pushCloudVault(
  clientId: string,
  payload: {
    tools: any[];
    notes: any[];
    media: any[];
    settings: any;
  }
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; version?: number; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/cloud/sync', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        clientId,
        ...payload,
      }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }
    const json = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; version?: number; error?: string };
    if (json.ok === false) {
      return { ok: false, error: json.error || 'Cloud vault could not be saved' };
    }
    return { ok: true, version: json.version };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to push vault data',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch MongoDB Atlas integration status.
 */
export async function fetchMongoStatus(): Promise<MongoStatus> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/cloud/mongo-status');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Status check failed');
    return await res.json();
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: false,
      isMongoConnected: false,
      hasCustomMongo: false,
      storageType: 'Persistent Cloud Store',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Connect to external MongoDB / MongoDB Atlas.
 */
export async function setMongoConnection(uri: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string }> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/cloud/mongo-config', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ uri }),
    });
    return await res.json();
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Network error connecting to MongoDB',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Initialize real-time multi-device synchronization via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
 */
export function setupRealtimeSync(
  clientId: string,
  onRemoteUpdate: (data: CloudVaultPayload) => void,
  onStatusChange?: (status: 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'reconnecting') => void
): () => void {
  let eventSource: EventSource | null = null;
  let reconnectTimer: any = null;
  let isClosed = false;
  let retryCount = 0;

  function connect() {
    if (isClosed) return;

    try {
      eventSource = new EventSource(`/api/cloud/events?clientId=${encodeURIComponent(clientId)}`);

      eventSource.addEventListener('connected', () => {
        retryCount = 0;
        onStatusChange?.('connected');
      });

      eventSource.addEventListener('vault_update', (e: MessageEvent) => {
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(e.data);
          // If the update came from another device, apply it seamlessly
          if (payload && payload.senderClientId !== clientId) {
            onRemoteUpdate(payload);
          }
        } catch (parseErr) {
          console.warn('[RealtimeSync] Could not parse vault_update event:', parseErr);
        }
      });

      eventSource.onerror = () => {
        if (eventSource) {
          eventSource.close();
          eventSource = null;
        }
        onStatusChange?.('reconnecting');
        if (!isClosed) {
          const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(1.5, retryCount), 15000);
          retryCount++;
          reconnectTimer = setTimeout(connect, delay);
        }
      };
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[RealtimeSync] Connection failed, retrying...', err);
      if (!isClosed) {
        reconnectTimer = setTimeout(connect, 3000);
      }
    }
  }

  // Focus and visibility listeners: whenever user returns to the tab on phone or desktop, re-sync immediately
  const handleVisibilityOrFocus = async () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
      try {
        const res = await fetchCloudVault();
        if (res.ok && res.data) {
          onRemoteUpdate(res.data);
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityOrFocus);
  window.addEventListener('focus', handleVisibilityOrFocus);

  // Background fallback poll every 20s for serverless environments (like Vercel)
  const pollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
      try {
        const res = await fetchCloudVault();
        if (res.ok && res.data) {
          onRemoteUpdate(res.data);
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }, 20000);

  return () => {
    isClosed = true;
    if (reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(reconnectTimer);
    if (pollInterval) clearInterval(pollInterval);
    window.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityOrFocus);
    window.removeEventListener('focus', handleVisibilityOrFocus);
    if (eventSource) {
      eventSource.close();
      eventSource = null;
    }
    onStatusChange?.('disconnected');
  };
}

/**
 * Legacy Supabase configuration helpers kept for backwards compatibility.
 */

const STORAGE_URL_KEY = '0arc_supabase_url';
const STORAGE_KEY_KEY = '0arc_supabase_anon_key';
const STORAGE_DISCONNECTED_KEY = '0arc_supabase_disconnected';

export interface SupabaseConfig {
  url: string;
  anonKey: string;
  source: 'env' | 'custom' | 'none';
}

export function getSupabaseConfig(): SupabaseConfig {
  let envUrl = '';
  let envKey = '';

  try {
    if (typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env) {
      envUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL as string | undefined)?.trim() || '';
      envKey = (import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY as string | undefined)?.trim() || '';
    }
  } catch {}

  if (envUrl && envKey) {
    return { url: envUrl, anonKey: envKey, source: 'env' };
  }

  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
      const storedUrl = (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_URL_KEY) || '').trim();
      const storedKey = (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_KEY) || '').trim();
      if (storedUrl && storedKey) {
        return { url: storedUrl, anonKey: storedKey, source: 'custom' };
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  return { url: '', anonKey: '', source: 'none' };
}

export function isSupabaseConfigured(): boolean {
  const config = getSupabaseConfig();
  return Boolean(config.url && config.anonKey);
}

export function isCloudSyncEnabled(): boolean {
  return true;
}

export function setCloudSyncEnabled(_enabled: boolean): void {}

export function saveSupabaseCredentials(url: string, anonKey: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_URL_KEY, url.trim());
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_KEY, anonKey.trim());
  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_DISCONNECTED_KEY);
}

export function clearSupabaseCredentials(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_URL_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY_KEY);
}

export function getSupabaseClient(): any {
  return null;
}

export function resetSupabaseClient(): void {}

export async function testSupabaseConnection(
  url: string,
  anonKey: string
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }> {
  if (!url || !anonKey) {
    return { ok: false, message: 'URL and Anon Key are required.' };
  }
  return { ok: true, message: 'Cloud connection active.' };
}
